en.t: Henry II crowned King of Germany at Mainz
en.s: On June 7, 1002, Archbishop Willigis crowned Henry II King of Germany at Mainz. This was his royal coronation; his coronation as Holy Roman Emperor followed in 1014.
en.n: This records the royal coronation, not the later imperial coronation.

zh.t: 亨利二世在美因茨加冕为德意志国王
zh.s: 1002年6月7日，美因茨大主教维利吉斯为亨利二世加冕，使其成为德意志国王。他后来于1014年加冕为神圣罗马皇帝。
zh.n: 此条记录为国王加冕，与后来成为皇帝的加冕仪式不同。

en.s: The siege of Jerusalem marked the successful end of the First Crusade, whose objective was the recovery of the city of Jerusalem and the Church of the Holy Sepulchre from Islamic control. The five-week siege began on 7 June 1099 and was carried out by the Christian forces of Western Europe mobilized by Pope Urban II after the Council of Clermont in 1095. The city had been out of Christian control since the Muslim conquest of the Levant in 637 and had been held for a century first by the Seljuk Turks and later by the Egyptian Fatimids.

zh.s: 耶路撒冷围城战标志着第一次十字军东征成功结束，其目标是从伊斯兰政权手中夺回耶路撒冷和圣墓教堂。围城持续五周，于1099年6月7日开始。西欧基督教军队在1095年克莱蒙会议后由教宗乌尔班二世动员，随后发动围城。耶路撒冷自637年黎凡特被穆斯林征服后便不再由基督徒控制，先后一个世纪由塞尔柱突厥人和埃及法蒂玛王朝统治。

en.s: The Battle of Malešov (Czech: Bitva u Malešova) was a battle of the Hussite Wars between the Orebites united armies under the command of Jan Žižka and the Prague Hussites with their Catholic allies that took place on 7 June 1424 near Malešov fortress, about 6 kilometres from Kutná Hora. The clash was won by Žižka's troops.

zh.s: 马列绍夫战役是胡斯战争期间的一场战斗，发生于1424年6月7日，交战双方是奥雷比特联合军（由扬·杰式卡指挥）以及布拉格胡斯派和其天主教盟友。杰式卡的部队获胜。

en.s: The Treaty of Tordesillas (Portuguese: Tratado de Tordesilhas [tɾɐˈtaðu ðɨ tuɾðɨˈziʎɐʃ], Spanish: Tratado de Tordesillas [tɾaˈtaðo ðe toɾðeˈsiʎas]), signed at Tordesillas on June 7, 1494, and authenticated at Setúbal, Portugal, divided the newly discovered lands outside Europe between Portugal and the Crown of Castile, along a meridian 370 leagues west of the Cape Verde islands, off the west coast of Africa. This line of demarcation was about halfway between the Cape Verde islands (already Portuguese) and the islands entered by Christopher Columbus on his first voyage (claimed for Castile and León), named in the treaty as Cipangu and Antilia (Cuba and Hispaniola).

zh.s: 《托尔德西里亚斯条约》（葡萄牙语：Tratado de Tordesilhas；西班牙语：Tratado de Tordesillas）于1494年6月7日在托尔德西里亚斯签署，并在葡萄牙塞图巴尔认证。条约以佛得角群岛以西370里格处的一条子午线为界，将欧洲以外新发现的土地划分给葡萄牙和卡斯蒂利亚王室。这条界线大致位于佛得角群岛（当时已属葡萄牙）与克里斯托弗·哥伦布首次航行所发现、由卡斯蒂利亚和莱昂声称拥有的岛屿之间；条约中将这些岛屿称为“契潘古”和“安的列斯”（即古巴和伊斯帕尼奥拉岛）。

en.s: The Battle of Lubny - battle fought between insurgent Cossacks and Polish troops from 26 May to 7 June 1596 during the Nalyvaiko Uprising.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 卢布内战役是纳雷瓦伊科起义期间，起义哥萨克与波兰军队交战的一场战役，发生于1596年5月26日至6月7日。

en.s: The Parliament of 1614 was the second Parliament of England of the reign of James VI and I and sat between 5 April and 7 June 1614. Lasting only two months and two days, it saw no bills pass and was not even regarded as a parliament by contemporaries. However, for its failure it has been known to posterity as the Addled Parliament.

zh.s: 1614年议会是英格兰国王詹姆斯六世及一世在位期间召开的第二届议会，会期为1614年4月5日至6月7日。议会仅持续两个月零两天，没有通过任何法案，当时人们甚至不把它视为真正的议会。由于毫无建树，后世称它为“混乱议会”。

en.s: The relief of Thionville (or the Battle of Thionville/Diedenhofen) took place on 7 June 1639, during the Thirty Years' War. The allied Imperial-Spanish forces under the overall command of Ottavio Piccolomini hammered the French force under the leadership of Marquis de Feuquieres, causing it to lift the siege of the Thionville stronghold.

zh.s: 蒂永维尔解围战又称蒂永维尔战役或迪登霍芬战役，于1639年6月7日三十年战争期间爆发。奥塔维奥·皮科洛米尼总司令率领帝国—西班牙联军猛烈进攻由富基耶尔侯爵率领的法军，迫使法军解除对蒂永维尔要塞的围困。

en.t: The Corpus de Sang uprising breaks out in Barcelona
en.s: On June 7, 1640, harvesters and townspeople rioted in Barcelona during the Corpus de Sang uprising. The viceroy of Catalonia, Dalmau de Queralt, was killed during the unrest.

zh.t: 巴塞罗那爆发“血腥圣体节”骚乱
zh.s: 1640年6月7日，收割者和当地居民在巴塞罗那发动骚乱，史称“血腥圣体节”。加泰罗尼亚总督达尔毛·德·克拉尔特在骚乱中遇害。

en.t: Louis XIV crowned King of France at Reims
en.s: Louis XIV was crowned King of France at Reims Cathedral on June 7, 1654. He had been king since 1643, when he was a child.

zh.t: 路易十四在兰斯加冕为法国国王
zh.s: 1654年6月7日，路易十四在兰斯主教座堂加冕为法国国王。他早在1643年便已继位，当时尚年幼。

en.s: The Battles of Schooneveld were two naval battles of the Franco-Dutch War, fought off the coast of the Netherlands on 7 June and 14 June 1673 (New Style; 28 May and 4 June in the Julian calendar then in use in England) between an allied Anglo-French fleet commanded by Prince Rupert of the Rhine on his flagship the Royal Charles, and the fleet of the United Provinces, commanded by Michiel de Ruyter.
en.n: This entry records the listed event date, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 斯洪内费尔德海战是法荷战争期间的两场海战，1673年6月7日和14日发生在荷兰海岸附近（当时英格兰使用儒略历，对应5月28日和6月4日）。莱茵河畔鲁珀特亲王率领英法联合舰队，旗舰为“皇家查尔斯”号；米希尔·德·鲁伊特率领联省舰队迎战。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件日期。

en.s: The siege of Luxembourg, in which Louis XIV of France (husband of Maria Theresa of Spain) laid siege to the Spanish-controlled Fortress of Luxembourg from 27 April to 7 June 1684, was the most significant confrontation of the War of the Reunions between France and Spain. The action caused alarm among France's neighbours and resulted in the formation of the League of Augsburg in 1686.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 法国国王路易十四（西班牙的玛丽亚·特蕾莎之夫）于1684年4月27日至6月7日围攻西班牙控制的卢森堡要塞，这是法国与西班牙“重聚战争”中最重要的一场战役。此战令法国邻国感到不安，并促成奥格斯堡同盟于1686年成立。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: On June 7, 1692, a powerful earthquake struck Port Royal, Jamaica. Much of the town was destroyed or sank into the sea, and a tsunami added to the devastation.

zh.t: 牙买加皇家港遭强烈地震
zh.s: 1692年6月7日，牙买加皇家港遭遇强烈地震。城镇大部分被毁，一些区域沉入海中，随后而来的海啸加重了灾情。

en.s: The Battle of Connecticut Farms, fought June 7, 1780, was one of the last major battles between British and American forces in the northern colonies during the American Revolutionary War. Hessian General Wilhelm von Knyphausen, in command of the British garrison at New York City, made an attempt to reach the principal Continental Army encampment at Morristown, New Jersey. Knyphausen's advance was strongly met by companies of the New Jersey militia at Connecticut Farms (present-day Union Township). After stiff resistance, the militia were forced to withdraw, but the battle and skirmishing that preceded it sufficiently delayed Knyphausen's advance that he remained there for the night.

zh.s: 康涅狄格农场战役于1780年6月7日爆发，是美国独立战争期间北方殖民地英美军队之间最后几场大型战役之一。威廉·冯·克尼普豪森伯爵率领的黑森军队驻守纽约市英军驻军，他试图前往新泽西州莫里斯敦的大陆军主要营地。新泽西民兵在康涅狄格农场（今联合镇）顽强迎战克尼普豪森的先头部队。民兵抵抗一阵后被迫撤退，但此前的战斗和小规模交火拖慢了克尼普豪森的进军，使他当晚留在原地。

en.s: The action of 7 June 1780 took place during the American War of Independence between the frigates Hermione and HMS Iris. The ships exchanged fire for one hour and a half before parting. The battle resumed in written form when James Hawker published his account of the battle in a newspaper, which Louis-René Levassor de Latouche Tréville contested heatedly.

zh.s: 1780年6月7日海战发生于美国独立战争期间，交战双方为法国护卫舰“赫敏”号和英国皇家海军“艾瑞斯”号。两舰交火一个半小时后分开。后来，詹姆斯·霍克在报纸上发表战斗记述，路易-勒内·拉图什-特雷维尔激烈反驳，战斗也因此在文字上延续。

en.s: The Battle of Richmond Hill, also known as the Battle of the Hawkesbury and the Richmond Hill Massacre, was a battle of the Hawkesbury and Nepean Wars, which were fought between the Indigenous Darug people and the New South Wales Corps (also including several armed settlers).

zh.s: 里士满山之战又称霍克斯伯里之战或里士满山屠杀，是霍克斯伯里和尼皮恩战争中的一场战斗，交战双方是原住民达鲁格人，以及新南威尔士军团和数名武装殖民者。

en.s: The Battle of Antrim was fought on 7 June 1798, in County Antrim, Ireland during the Irish Rebellion of 1798 between British troops and Irish insurgents led by Henry Joy McCracken. The British won the battle, beating off a rebel attack on Antrim town following the arrival of reinforcements but the county governor, Lord O'Neill, was fatally wounded.

zh.s: 安特里姆战役于1798年6月7日在爱尔兰安特里姆郡爆发，是1798年爱尔兰叛乱的一部分，交战双方为英军和亨利·乔伊·麦克拉肯领导的爱尔兰起义军。增援部队抵达后，英军击退了起义军对安特里姆镇的进攻并赢得战斗。郡长奥尼尔勋爵则身负重伤，最终死亡。

en.s: The First Battle of Zurich, from 4 to 7 June 1799, forced French General André Masséna to yield the city of Zurich to the Austrians, under Archduke Charles, and to retreat beyond the Limmat, where he managed to fortify his positions, which resulted in a stalemate. The first battle of Zurich saw Austrian attacks on strong French positions, which were captured but then had to be abandoned due to a French counterattack.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 第一次苏黎世战役于1799年6月4日至7日进行，安德烈·马塞纳将军率领的法军被迫将苏黎世让给查理大公率领的奥军，并撤至利马特河对岸。法军随后巩固阵地，战局陷入僵持。奥军曾攻占法军坚固阵地，但随后因法军反击而被迫放弃。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Alcolea Bridge was a minor battle that took place on 7 June 1808, during the Peninsular War, at Alcolea, a small village 10 km from Córdoba, the city that would be invaded by French troops later that same afternoon.

zh.s: 阿尔科莱亚桥战役于1808年6月7日半岛战争期间爆发，是一场小规模战斗，地点在距科尔多瓦市10公里的小村阿尔科莱亚。当天稍晚，法军将入侵科尔多瓦。

en.s: The Battle of Hasan Abdal took place on June 7, 1813, between the Sikhs led by Bhayya Ram Singh and Afghans led by Fateh Khan Barakzai at Hasan Abdal.

zh.s: 哈桑阿卜杜勒战役于1813年6月7日爆发，交战双方是巴亚·拉姆·辛格率领的锡克军和法塔赫·汗·巴拉克扎伊率领的阿富汗军，地点在哈桑阿卜杜勒。

en.s: The siege of Jerusalem of 1834 took place during the Peasants' revolt in Palestine, which erupted following the entry of Egyptian general Ibrahim Pasha into Ottoman Syria and his subsequent military conscription demand upon the Arab villagers of the region. The siege was engaged by local Arab peasant rebels upon an Egyptian garrison of about 2,000 soldiers, beginning from May 21 until the arrival of Ibrahim Pasha's main force on June 7.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1834年耶路撒冷围城战发生于巴勒斯坦农民起义期间。埃及将领易卜拉欣帕夏进入奥斯曼叙利亚，并要求阿拉伯村民服兵役，引发起义。当地阿拉伯农民起义军于5月21日开始围攻约2,000名埃及驻军，直到6月7日易卜拉欣帕夏主力部队抵达。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Revolution of the Reforms was a military movement in Venezuela between 7 June 1835, and 1 March 1836, against the government of José María Vargas, the conservative Congress, and the influence of José Antonio Páez. It was led by outstanding independence heroes such as Santiago Mariño, Diego Ibarra, Pedro Briceño Méndez, José Laurencio Silva, José María Melo, Blas Bruzual, Luis Perú de Lacroix, Pedro Carujo, José Tadeo Monagas, Renato Beluche, Andrés Level de Goda, and Estanislao Rendon.

zh.s: 改革运动起义于1835年6月7日至1836年3月1日在委内瑞拉爆发，是一场反对何塞·玛丽亚·巴尔加斯政府、保守派国会及何塞·安东尼奥·派斯影响力的军事运动。起义由多位著名独立战争英雄领导，包括圣地亚哥·马里尼奥、迭戈·伊瓦拉、佩德罗·布里塞尼奥·门德斯、何塞·劳伦西奥·席尔瓦、何塞·玛丽亚·梅洛、布拉斯·布鲁苏阿尔、路易斯·佩鲁·德拉克鲁瓦、佩德罗·卡鲁霍、何塞·塔德奥·莫纳加斯、雷纳托·贝卢切、安德烈斯·莱韦尔·德戈达和埃斯塔尼斯劳·伦东。

en.s: The Battle of Káty was fought between the Hungarian IV corps led by General Mór Perczel and the Austrian and Croatian soldiers of the Southern Army led by the Ban of Croatia Lieutenant Field Marshal Josip Jelačić, as part of the fight for southern Hungary, consisting of the Bácska and Bánság provinces, at 7 June 1849, as part of the Summer Campaign of the 1848-1849 Hungarian Revolution of 1848 and Freedom War.

zh.s: 卡蒂战役于1849年6月7日爆发，是1848—1849年匈牙利革命和自由战争夏季战役的一部分。匈牙利第四军团由莫尔·佩尔采尔将军率领，南方军由克罗地亚总督、陆军元帅约瑟普·耶拉契奇率领，后者的部队由奥地利和克罗地亚士兵组成。双方为争夺匈牙利南部的巴奇卡和巴纳特省而战。

en.s: Skirmish of Halkokari, 7 June 1854, was a short coastal battle during the Åland War, a part of the Anglo–French Baltic Sea campaign in Crimean War. It was fought between a British landing detachment and the local coastal troops of Russian Grand Duchy of Finland at cape Halkokari, Kokkola.

zh.s: 哈尔科卡里遭遇战于1854年6月7日爆发，是克里米亚战争期间英法波罗的海战役中的一场短暂海岸战斗。交战双方是英国登陆分队与芬兰大公国当地海岸部队，地点在科科拉的哈尔科卡里角。

en.t: 1858–59 United States House of Representatives elections
en.s: States held the 1858–59 United States House of Representatives elections between June 7, 1858, and December 1, 1859, during President James Buchanan's term. Each state set a date for its elections to the House. Voters in 34 states, including the new state of Oregon and the pending new state of Kansas, elected 238 Representatives before the first session of the 36th United States Congress convened on December 5, 1859.

zh.s: 美国各州于1858年6月7日至1859年12月1日举行众议院选举，时任总统詹姆斯·布坎南在任。各州自行确定选举日期。34个州的选民选出238名众议员，其中包括新州俄勒冈州和即将成为新州的堪萨斯州；第36届美国国会第一次会议于1859年12月5日召开。

en.s: The 1858 Oregon gubernatorial election took place on June 7, 1858, to elect the first governor in anticipation of Oregon statehood. With the state Democratic Party split into factions driven by personal rivalry and state government influence, the election matched insurgent E. M. Barnum against establishment candidate John Whiteaker, who won. The Republican Party first nominated John Denny, but he later withdrew in favor of the insurgent Democrat, whom the party hoped to win over to the Republicans.

zh.s: 1858年俄勒冈州州长选举于6月7日举行，为俄勒冈即将建州选出首任州长。州民主党因个人竞争和州政府影响力之争而分裂，共和党候选人E·M·巴纳姆与建制派候选人约翰·怀特克竞选，怀特克获胜。共和党最初提名约翰·丹尼，后者随后退选，转而支持共和党希望争取入党的反叛民主党人。

en.s: The First Battle of Chattanooga was a minor artillery battle in the American Civil War, fought on June 7–8, 1862.

zh.s: 第一次查塔努加战役是美国内战期间的一场小规模炮战，于1862年6月7日至8日进行。

loc: 美国路易斯安那州麦迪逊堂区

en.s: The Battle of Milliken's Bend, fought June 7, 1863, was part of the Vicksburg Campaign of the American Civil War. Confederate Lt. Gen. John C. Pemberton and his army were besieged in Vicksburg, Mississippi, by Union commander Maj. Gen. Ulysses S. Grant and the Army of the Tennessee. In an effort to cut Grant's supply line and relieve the city, the Confederates attacked the Union supply area at Milliken's Bend up the Mississippi. The Milliken's Bend area, 15 miles to the northwest of Vicksburg, had until recently served as a staging area for Grant's Vicksburg Campaign.

zh.s: 米利肯湾战役于1863年6月7日爆发，是美国内战维克斯堡战役的一部分。邦联中将约翰·C·彭伯顿及其部队被联邦少将尤利西斯·S·格兰特和田纳西军围困在密西西比州维克斯堡。为切断格兰特的补给线并解救该城，邦联军向密西西比河上游的米利肯湾联邦补给区发动进攻。米利肯湾位于维克斯堡西北15英里处，此前不久一直是格兰特维克斯堡战役的集结地。

en.s: The Second Chōshū expedition (Japanese: 第二次長州征討), also called the Summer War, was a punitive expedition led by the Tokugawa shogunate against the Chōshū Domain in 1866. It followed the First Chōshū expedition of 1864.

zh.s: 第二次征长州之役又称“夏之战”，是德川幕府于1866年对长州藩发动的讨伐行动，此前幕府曾在1864年发动第一次征长州之役。

en.s: The Battle of Ybytimí was fought in June 1869, during the opening stages of the Paraguayan War's Campaign of the Hills. The allied army was conducting raids in central Paraguay and gearing up to resume campaigning against the reorganized Paraguayan army, it having been mostly destroyed during the Pikysyry campaign. A column of raiders was ambushed by a 600-strong Paraguayan force and forced to retreat.

zh.s: 伊比蒂米之战发生于1869年6月，是巴拉圭战争“山地战役”初期的一场战斗。联军当时在巴拉圭中部展开袭击，并准备继续进攻经历皮基西里战役重创后重新集结的巴拉圭军队。一支联军袭击部队遭约600名巴拉圭士兵伏击，被迫撤退。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in France on 24 May and 1 June 1869, with a second round on 6 and 7 June. These elections resulted in a victory for the regime of the Second Empire, but the opposition strengthened its presence in the legislature. Nationwide, the regime won 55% of the vote. In Paris, the opposition parties (mostly Republicans) won 75% of the vote; however, the regime won large majorities in the countryside.
en.n: This entry records the second round, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 法国于1869年5月24日和6月1日举行议会选举，第二轮投票于6月6日和7日举行。选举结果是第二帝国政权获胜，但反对派在立法机构中的席位有所增加。全国范围内，政权获得55%的选票。在巴黎，反对党（主要是共和党）获得75%的选票，但政权在乡村地区赢得了多数席位。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的第二轮投票日期。

en.s: The Battle of Arica, also known as Assault and Capture of Cape Arica, was a battle in the War of the Pacific. It was fought on 7 June 1880, between the forces of Chile and Peru. After the Battle of Tacna and the following Bolivian withdrawal from the war, Peru had to stand alone for the rest of the conflict. The need for a port near to the location of the army, in order to supply and reinforce the troops and evacuate wounded, made the Chilean command put its attention on the remaining Peruvian stronghold in the Tacna Department.

zh.s: 阿里卡战役又称阿里卡角突袭与占领战，是太平洋战争中的一场战役，于1880年6月7日由智利和秘鲁军队交战。塔克纳战役后，玻利维亚退出战争，秘鲁不得不独自继续作战。智利军方需要在军队附近建立港口，以便为部队补给、增援并撤出伤员，因此将注意力转向塔克纳省剩余的秘鲁据点。

en.s: The 1886 Oregon gubernatorial election took place on June 7, 1886 to elect the governor of the U.S. state of Oregon. The election matched Republican former state senator Thomas R. Cornelius against Democrat Sylvester Pennoyer. Pennoyer gained support for advocating the use of American labor over Chinese immigrants.

zh.s: 1886年俄勒冈州州长选举于6月7日举行，选举美国俄勒冈州州长。共和党候选人、前州参议员托马斯·R·科尼利厄斯与民主党候选人西尔维斯特·彭诺耶竞选。彭诺耶主张优先雇用美国劳工而非中国移民，因此获得支持。

en.t: Homer Plessy arrested after challenging Louisiana train segregation
en.s: On June 7, 1892, Homer Plessy deliberately took a seat in a whites-only railroad car in New Orleans to challenge Louisiana’s segregation law. He was arrested after refusing to leave; the court case that became Plessy v. Ferguson followed later.

zh.t: 荷马·普莱西因挑战火车种族隔离规定被捕
zh.s: 1892年6月7日，荷马·普莱西为挑战路易斯安那州的种族隔离法，故意坐进新奥尔良火车的“白人专用”车厢，拒绝离开后被捕。这次行动后来引出了“普莱西诉弗格森案”。

en.s: The Battle of Ferkeh (or Firket) occurred during the Mahdist War when an army of the Mahdist Sudanese was surprised and wiped out by the British and Egyptian forces under Sir Herbert Kitchener on 7 June 1896. In 1896, as part of the Sudan campaign, Kitchener's Anglo-Egyptian force was advancing on Dongola, in Northern Sudan. Ferkeh was a small fortified village on the banks of the Nile. It was the first important Mahdist position they encountered. At the time, it was occupied by 3,000 Mahdist warriors, led by the Emirs Hammuda and Osman Azrak.

zh.s: 费尔凯战役（又称菲尔凯战役）于1896年6月7日马赫迪战争期间爆发。基奇纳爵士率领的英埃联军突袭并歼灭了苏丹马赫迪军队。1896年，作为苏丹战役的一部分，基奇纳的英埃部队正向苏丹北部的栋古拉推进。费尔凯是尼罗河岸边一座小型设防村庄，也是他们遇到的第一个重要马赫迪据点。当时，该地驻有3,000名马赫迪战士，由哈穆达和奥斯曼·阿兹拉克两位埃米尔率领。

en.t: Norway’s parliament declares the union with Sweden dissolved
en.s: On June 7, 1905, Norway’s parliament declared its union with Sweden dissolved, following a plan led by Prime Minister Christian Michelsen. Negotiations followed, and Sweden recognised Norwegian independence on October 26.
en.n: This records the parliamentary declaration, rather than Sweden’s later recognition.

zh.t: 挪威议会宣布解除与瑞典的联盟
zh.s: 1905年6月7日，挪威议会依照首相克里斯蒂安·米克尔森推动的方案，宣布解除与瑞典的联盟。双方随后展开谈判，瑞典于10月26日承认挪威独立。
zh.n: 此条记录为议会宣布解盟，瑞典正式承认挪威独立是在后来。

en.s: RMS Lusitania was a British ocean liner launched by the Cunard Line in 1906 as a Royal Mail Ship. She was the world's largest passenger ship until the completion of her sister Mauretania three months later. In 1907, she gained the Blue Riband appellation for the fastest Atlantic crossing, which had been held by German ships for a decade.

zh.s: 英国冠达航运公司的卢西塔尼亚号于1906年下水，是一艘皇家邮船。直到姊妹船毛里塔尼亚号三个月后建成，它一直是世界上最大的客船。1907年，卢西塔尼亚号因创下最快横渡大西洋纪录获得“蓝丝带”称号，此前这一纪录由德国船只保持了十年。

en.s: The Battle of Messines (7–14 June 1917) was an offensive conducted by the British Second Army, under the command of General Sir Herbert Plumer, on the Western Front near the village of Messines in West Flanders, Belgium, during the First World War. The Nivelle Offensive in April and May had failed to achieve its more ambitious aims, led to the demoralisation of French troops and the dislocation of the Anglo-French strategy for 1917. The offensive at Messines forced the Germans to move reserves to Flanders from the Arras and Aisne fronts, which relieved pressure on the French.

zh.s: 梅西讷战役于1917年6月7日至14日进行，是第一次世界大战期间英国第二集团军在西线发动的一次攻势，战场位于比利时西佛兰德省梅西讷村附近。赫伯特·普卢默将军指挥英军作战。4、5月间的尼维尔攻势未能实现更大的目标，导致法军士气低落，也打乱了英法两军1917年的作战计划。梅西讷攻势迫使德军将预备队从阿拉斯和埃纳战线调往佛兰德，从而减轻了法军压力。

en.s: The Capture of Wytschaete was a tactical incident in the Battle of Messines (7–14 June 1917) on the Western Front during the First World War. On 7 June, the ridge was attacked by the British Second Army; the 36th (Ulster) Division and the 16th (Irish) Division of IX Corps captured the fortified village of Wytschaete on the plateau of Messines Ridge, which had been held by the German 4th Army since the First Battle of Ypres (19 October – 22 November 1914).

zh.s: 怀茨哈特镇被攻占是1917年6月7日梅西讷战役（6月7日至14日）中的一次战术行动，发生在第一次世界大战西线。当天，英国第二集团军进攻山脊；第36（阿尔斯特）师和第九军第16（爱尔兰）师攻占梅西讷山脊高原上的设防村庄怀茨哈特。德军第四集团军自第一次伊普尔战役（1914年10月19日至11月22日）以来一直控制该村。

en.s: The 1917 Alberta general election was held on 7 June 1917 to elect members of the Legislative Assembly of Alberta. The Liberals won a fourth term in office, defeating most of the candidates of the Conservative Party, led by Edward Michener, Socialist, Non-Partisan League and Labour slates. The Liberals also secured several seats due to their members being on active service in World War I.

zh.s: 艾伯塔省于1917年6月7日举行大选，选举省议会议员。自由党连任第四届，击败由爱德华·米切纳领导的大多数保守党候选人，以及社会主义党、无党派联盟和工党候选人。自由党的一些议员在第一次世界大战期间现役，也帮助该党赢得了多个席位。

en.t: The Sette Giugno riots break out in Malta
en.s: On June 7, 1919, riots broke out in Valletta, Malta, amid anger over living costs and colonial rule. British troops fired on the crowd. Four Maltese people died during the unrest.

zh.t: 马耳他爆发“六月七日”骚乱
zh.s: 1919年6月7日，马耳他瓦莱塔爆发骚乱，民众抗议生活成本上涨和殖民统治。英军向人群开火，骚乱中有四名马耳他人死亡。

en.s: The Battle of Fengwudong (Korean: 봉오동 전투; Hanja: 鳳梧洞戰鬪) was a battle between Korean independence militias and Japanese forces in Manchuria. It took place between 6 and 7 June 1920, and was one of the earliest domestic support operations of the Korean independence forces. It was a battle in which independence army units defeated the Japanese regular army in Bongo-dong, Manchuria in 1920.

zh.s: 风梧洞战役（韩语：봉오동 전투；汉字：鳳梧洞戰鬪）是1920年6月6日至7日发生在满洲的一场战斗，交战双方为朝鲜独立民兵和日本军队。这是朝鲜独立军最早的本土支援行动之一。朝鲜独立军部队在满洲凤梧洞击败了日本正规军。

en.s: The Westminster St George's by-election of 1921 was held on 7 June 1921. The by-election was held due to the elevation to the peerage of the incumbent Coalition Conservative MP, Walter Long. It was won by the Anti-Waste League candidate James Malcolm Monteith Erskine.

zh.t: 1921年威斯敏斯特圣乔治区补选
zh.s: 威斯敏斯特圣乔治区于1921年6月7日举行补选。补选因在任联合保守党议员沃尔特·朗获封贵族而举行。反浪费联盟候选人詹姆斯·马尔科姆·蒙蒂思·厄斯金赢得席位。

en.s: The 1921 Los Angeles mayoral election took place on June 7, 1921. Incumbent Meredith P. Snyder was defeated by George E. Cryer. It was the last time Snyder ran for Mayor. Municipal elections in California, including Mayor of Los Angeles, are officially nonpartisan; candidates' party affiliations do not appear on the ballot.

zh.s: 洛杉矶市长选举于1921年6月7日举行。时任市长梅雷迪思·P·斯奈德败给乔治·E·克赖尔。这是斯奈德最后一次竞选市长。加州市政选举在法律上不设党派，候选人的党派归属不会出现在选票上。

en.s: On 7 June 1922, ships of the Greek Navy bombarded the Turkish town of Samsun for three hours (15:02–18:00), firing 400 rounds; while in response, the single Turkish artillery piece in the town fired back 25 rounds. While the American destroyers USS Sands, USS McFarland, and USS Sturtevant were present, they did not participate in the bombardment.

zh.s: 1922年6月7日，希腊海军舰艇炮击土耳其萨姆松镇，持续3小时（15时02分至18时），共发射400发炮弹。镇上唯一的一门土耳其火炮则回击25发炮弹。美国驱逐舰“桑兹”号、“麦克法兰”号和“斯特特万特”号当时在场，但没有参与炮击。

en.s: From February 12 to June 7, 1924, voters of the Republican Party chose its nominee for president in the 1924 United States presidential election. Only 17 states held Republican primaries that year, with most states selecting Convention delegates through caucuses and state-level conventions. Delegates chosen through the primary process (in those states that held primary elections) attended the 1924 Republican National Convention held from June 10 to June 12, 1924, in Cleveland, Ohio.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 共和党选民于1924年2月12日至6月7日选出该党在1924年美国总统选举中的候选人。当年只有17个州举行共和党初选，多数州通过党团会议和州级代表大会选出代表。举行初选的州选出的代表参加了1924年6月10日至12日在俄亥俄州克利夫兰举行的共和党全国代表大会。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: From March 12 to June 7, 1924, voters and members of the Democratic Party elected delegates to the 1924 Democratic National Convention, in part to nominate a candidate for President of the United States in the 1924 election. Though William Gibbs McAdoo won a vast majority of states, and almost three-fifths of the popular vote, in those twelve states that held primary elections, it meant little to his performance nationwide.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 民主党选民和党员于1924年3月12日至6月7日选出代表，参加民主党全国代表大会，并部分为1924年美国总统选举提名候选人。威廉·吉布斯·麦卡杜赢得绝大多数州的初选，在举行初选的12个州中获得近五分之三的普选票，但这对他在全国范围内的表现帮助不大。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Lateran Treaty was one component of the Lateran Pacts of 1929, agreements between Italy under King Victor Emmanuel III and Duce Benito Mussolini and the Holy See under Pope Pius XI to settle the long-standing Roman question. The treaty recognised Vatican City as an independent state under the sovereignty of the Holy See. Italy also agreed to give the Catholic Church financial compensation for the loss of the Papal States.
en.n: The Lateran Treaty is ratified, bringing Vatican City into existence.

zh.s: 拉特兰条约是1929年拉特兰条约组中的一项协议，由维克托·埃曼努尔三世国王、贝尼托·墨索里尼首相领导下的意大利与教宗庇护十一世领导下的圣座签署，旨在解决长期悬而未决的“罗马问题”。条约承认梵蒂冈城国为独立国家，由圣座拥有主权。意大利还同意向天主教会提供经济补偿，弥补教皇国失去的领土。
zh.n: 《拉特兰条约》获得批准，梵蒂冈城国由此成立。

en.s: The coup d'état attempt in 1934 (Lithuanian: 1934-ųjų pučas) was an attempt by voldemarininkai, supporters of the former Prime Minister Augustinas Voldemaras, to overthrow the government of President Antanas Smetona. While voldemarininkai planned several coups against the government, this coup was the largest and most threatening. Voldemaras was ousted as Prime Minister in September 1929, but still enjoyed considerable support among the members of the liquidated Iron Wolf and many younger military officers.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1934年，支持前总理奥古斯蒂纳斯·沃尔德马拉斯的人试图推翻总统安塔纳斯·斯梅托纳的政府。虽然他们此前还策划过数次政变，但这次规模最大、威胁也最严重。沃尔德马拉斯虽在1929年9月被免去总理职务，仍得到已解散的“铁狼”组织成员和许多年轻军官支持。
zh.n: 本条记录的是原文资料框所列政变企图的结束日期。

en.s: The 1938 Yellow River flood (simplified Chinese: 花园口决堤事件; traditional Chinese: 花園口決堤事件; pinyin: Huāyuánkǒu Juédī Shìjiàn; lit. 'Huayuankou Dam Burst Incident') was a man-made flood in China from June 1938 to January 1947 created by the intentional destruction of levees on the Yellow River in Huayuankou, Henan, by the National Revolutionary Army (NRA) during the Second Sino-Japanese War. The first wave of floods hit Zhongmu County on 13 June 1938.
en.n: Second Sino-Japanese War: The Chinese Nationalist government creates the 1938 Yellow River flood to halt Japanese forces. Five hundred thousand to nine hundred thousand civilians are killed.

zh.s: 1938年黄河洪灾是中国人为制造的洪灾，始于1938年6月，持续至1947年1月。第二次中日战争期间，国民革命军在河南花园口人为炸毁黄河堤坝。洪水首波于1938年6月13日抵达中牟县。
zh.n: 第二次中日战争：中国国民政府制造1938年黄河洪灾，以阻挡日军。50万至90万平民死亡。

en.s: The Newcastle upon Tyne North by-election, 1940 was a parliamentary by-election held on 7 June 1940 for the British House of Commons constituency of Newcastle upon Tyne North.

zh.s: 英国下议院纽卡斯尔北区选区于1940年6月7日举行议会补选。

en.t: Bombing of Berlin in World War II
en.s: Berlin, the capital of Germany, was subject to 363 air raids during the Second World War. It was bombed by the RAF Bomber Command between 1940 and 1945, the United States Army Air Forces' Eighth Air Force between 1943 and 1945, and the French Air Force in 1940 and between 1944 and 1945 as part of the Allied campaign of strategic bombing of Germany.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 二战期间，德国首都柏林遭到363次空袭。英国皇家空军轰炸机司令部在1940年至1945年轰炸柏林，美国陆军航空军第八航空队在1943年至1945年参与轰炸；法国空军则于1940年和1944年至1945年对柏林发动空袭。这些空袭属于盟军对德国的战略轰炸。
zh.n: 本条记录的是原文资料框所列空袭时期的开始日期。

en.t: Battle of Midway ends in an American victory
en.s: The Battle of Midway ended on June 7, 1942. In the battle, fought near Midway Atoll in the Pacific, U.S. forces defeated Japan’s Combined Fleet. The main naval engagement ran from June 4 to 7 and became a major battle of the Second World War.
en.n: This records the battle’s end date; the main engagement began on June 4.

zh.t: 中途岛海战以美军胜利告终
zh.s: 1942年6月7日，中途岛海战结束。海战发生在太平洋中途岛附近，美军击败了日本联合舰队。主要交战从6月4日持续至7日，是二战太平洋战场上的重要战役。
zh.n: 此条记录海战结束日，主要交战从6月4日开始。

en.t: Japanese troops land on Attu in Alaska
en.s: On June 7, 1942, Japanese army troops landed on Attu in Alaska’s Aleutian Islands, beginning the Japanese occupation of the island during World War II.

zh.t: 日军登陆阿拉斯加阿图岛
zh.s: 1942年6月7日，日本陆军部队登陆阿拉斯加阿留申群岛的阿图岛，开始在第二次世界大战期间占领该岛。

en.s: Kovel Uzel - code name of the sabotage operation carried out by Soviet partisans from 7 June 1943 to 14 March 1944 in the area of Kovel railway junction.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 科韦利乌泽尔是苏联游击队一次破坏行动的代号，行动于1943年6月7日至1944年3月14日在科韦利铁路枢纽一带开展。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.s: Operation Tonga was the codename given to the airborne operation undertaken by the British 6th Airborne Division between 5 June and 7 June 1944 as a part of Operation Overlord and the D-Day landings during the Second World War. The paratroopers and glider-borne airborne troops of the division, commanded by Major-General Richard Nelson Gale, landed on the eastern flank of the invasion area, near to the city of Caen, tasked with a number of objectives.

zh.s: 汤加行动是英国第6空降师于1944年6月5日至7日实施的空降作战行动代号，属于霸王行动和第二次世界大战D日登陆的一部分。理查德·纳尔逊·盖尔少将指挥的师属伞兵和滑翔机空降部队在登陆区东侧、卡昂附近着陆，执行多项目标。

en.s: The Ardenne Abbey massacre occurred during the Battle of Normandy at the Ardenne Abbey, a Premonstratensian monastery in Saint-Germain-la-Blanche-Herbe, near Caen, France. In June 1944, 20 Canadian soldiers were massacred in a garden at the abbey by members of the 12th SS Panzer Division Hitlerjugend over the course of several days and weeks.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 诺曼底战役期间，法国卡昂附近圣日耳曼拉布朗什埃尔布的阿登修道院发生屠杀事件。1944年6月，党卫军第12“希特勒青年团”装甲师成员在数天至数周内于修道院花园杀害了20名加拿大士兵。
zh.n: 本条记录的是原文资料框所列事件的开始日期。

en.s: The Battle of Merville Gun Battery was a series of British assaults beginning 6 June 1944, as part of Operation Tonga, part of the Normandy landings, during the Second World War. Allied intelligence believed the Merville Gun Battery was composed of heavy-calibre 150 mm (5.9 in) guns that could threaten the British landings at Sword Beach, only 8 miles (13 km) away.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 梅维尔炮台战役是英国军队于1944年6月6日开始发动的一系列进攻，属于汤加行动和第二次世界大战诺曼底登陆的一部分。盟军情报部门认为，梅维尔炮台装备了重型150毫米（5.9英寸）口径火炮，可能威胁仅8英里（13公里）外的英军剑滩登陆部队。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: Operation Hasty was a mission behind German lines in Italy, during the Second World War. The operation was carried out in June 1944, by a small force of 60 men drawn from the 2nd Independent Parachute Brigade. Their objective was to land behind German positions in the Abruzzo region near Trasacco and interdict supply lines and the movement of troops as they withdrew from Sora to Avezzano.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 二战期间，一支由第二独立伞兵旅抽调的60人小队于1944年6月在意大利执行“仓促行动”，深入德军后方。他们计划空降到阿布鲁佐大区特拉萨科附近，阻断德军从索拉向阿韦扎诺撤退时的补给线和部队调动。
zh.n: 本条记录的是原文资料框所列行动的结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of West Hunan (Chinese: 湘西會戰), also known as the Battle of Xuefeng Mountains (Chinese: 雪峰山戰役) and the Zhijiang Campaign (Chinese: 芷江戰役), was the Japanese invasion of west Hunan and the subsequent Allied counterattack that occurred between 6 April and 7 June 1945, during the last months of the Second Sino-Japanese War.
en.n: The Battle of West Hunan (Chinese: 湘西會戰), also known as the Battle of Xuefeng Mountains (Chinese: 雪峰山戰役) and the Zhijiang Campaign (Chinese: 芷江戰役), was the Japanese invasion of west Hunan and the subsequent Allied counterattack that occurred between 6 April and 7 June 1945, during the last months of the Second Sino-Japanese War.

zh.s: 湘西会战又称雪峰山战役、芷江战役，是日本进攻湖南西部及盟军随后反攻的一系列战事，发生于1945年4月6日至6月7日，处于第二次中日战争的最后几个月。
zh.n: 湘西会战又称雪峰山战役、芷江战役，是日本进攻湖南西部及盟军随后反攻的一系列战事，发生于1945年4月6日至6月7日，处于第二次中日战争的最后几个月。

en.s: The 1948 Ontario general election was held on June 7, 1948, to elect the 90 members of the 23rd Legislative Assembly of Ontario (Members of Provincial Parliament, or "MPPs") of the province of Ontario. The Ontario Progressive Conservative Party, led by George Drew, won a third consecutive term in office, winning a solid majority of seats in the legislature—53, down from 66 in the previous election.

zh.s: 安大略省于1948年6月7日举行大选，选出第23届立法议会90名省议员。乔治·德鲁领导的安大略进步保守党连续第三次执政，在议会赢得稳固多数席位，共获53席，低于上次选举的66席。

en.t: Edvard Beneš resigns as President of Czechoslovakia
en.s: On June 7, 1948, Edvard Beneš resigned as President of Czechoslovakia after refusing to sign the new constitution following the Communist takeover. His resignation letter was released to the press the next day.
en.n: June 7 is the date of the resignation letter; its release to the press followed on June 8.

zh.t: 贝奈斯辞去捷克斯洛伐克总统职务
zh.s: 1948年6月7日，爱德华·贝奈斯辞去捷克斯洛伐克总统职务。此前，他拒绝签署共产党掌权后的新宪法。他的辞职信在次日向新闻界公布。
zh.n: 6月7日为辞职信上的日期，向新闻界公布是在6月8日。

en.s: General elections were held in Italy on Sunday June 7, 1953, to choose the Second Republican Parliament. They were a test for leading centrist coalition ruled by Prime Minister Alcide De Gasperi.

zh.s: 意大利于1953年6月7日（星期日）举行大选，选出第二届共和国议会。这次选举是对阿尔契德·德加斯佩总理领导的中间派执政联盟的一次考验。

en.s: Lombardy elected its second delegation to the Italian Senate on June 7, 1953. This election was a part of national Italian general election of 1953 even if, according to the Italian Constitution, every senatorial challenge in each Region is a single and independent race. The election was won by the centrist Christian Democracy, as it happened at national level.

zh.t: 1953年伦巴第大区意大利参议院选举
zh.s: 伦巴第大区于1953年6月7日选出第二届意大利参议院代表团。虽然这场选举属于1953年意大利大选的一部分，但根据意大利宪法，各大区的参议院选举都是独立选举。中间派基督教民主党获胜，与该党在全国大选中的表现相同。

en.s: Operation Lucky Alphonse was a failed British Armed Forces operation that occurred during the EOKA insurgency in Cyprus. The British military sustained more than 30 casualties, mostly from an accidental forest fire.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: “幸运阿方斯”行动是英国军队在塞浦路斯EOKA武装起义期间发动的一次失败行动。英军伤亡超过30人，大多由意外发生的森林火灾造成。
zh.n: 本条记录的是原文资料框所列行动的开始日期。

en.s: The 1960 Nova Scotia general election was held on 7 June 1960 to elect members of the 47th House of Assembly of the province of Nova Scotia, Canada. It was won by the Progressive Conservatives.

zh.s: 加拿大新斯科舍省于1960年6月7日举行大选，选出第47届省议会议员。进步保守党获胜。

en.t: 1960 Democratic Party presidential primary season ends
en.s: From March 8 to June 7, 1960, Democratic voters and party members chose national convention delegates through primaries, caucuses and local conventions. Several leading contenders did not enter the primaries, so the contests did not settle the nomination. The national convention in Los Angeles in July ultimately nominated John F. Kennedy.
en.n: June 7 is the end date of the primary series; the nominating convention took place in July.

zh.t: 1960年美国民主党总统初选结束
zh.s: 1960年3月8日至6月7日，美国民主党通过初选、党团会议和地方大会选出全国代表大会代表。由于多名主要竞争者没有参加初选，结果并未直接决定总统候选人。7月在洛杉矶举行的全国代表大会最终提名了约翰·F·肯尼迪。
zh.n: 6月7日为这一轮初选的结束日期，提名总统候选人的全国代表大会在7月举行。

en.s: From March 8 to June 7, 1960, voters of the Republican Party elected delegates to the 1960 Republican National Convention, in part to choose the party nominee for president in the 1960 United States presidential election. Incumbent vice president Richard Nixon faced no formidable opposition for the nomination. There were significant efforts by liberals to draft New York governor Nelson Rockefeller as a candidate.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 共和党选民于1960年3月8日至6月7日选出代表，参加共和党全国代表大会，并为1960年美国总统选举提名候选人。时任副总统理查德·尼克松没有遇到有力竞争。自由派曾大力推动纽约州州长纳尔逊·洛克菲勒参选。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: Griswold v. Connecticut, 381 U.S. 479 (1965), is a landmark decision of the U.S. Supreme Court in which the Court ruled that the Constitution of the United States protects the liberty of married couples to use contraceptives without government restriction. The case involved a Connecticut law that prohibited the use of "any drug, medicinal article or instrument for the purpose of preventing conception".
en.n: This entry records the decision, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.t: 格里斯沃尔德诉康涅狄格州案
zh.s: 格里斯沃尔德诉康涅狄格州案（381 U.S. 479，1965年）是美国最高法院的一项里程碑式裁决。法院裁定，美国宪法保障已婚夫妇在不受政府限制的情况下使用避孕用品。案件涉及康涅狄格州一项法律，该法禁止为避孕目的使用“任何药物、医疗用品或器具”。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的裁决日期。

en.s: The 1967 Urban Council Election was held on 7 June 1967 for the 5 of the 10 elected seats of the Urban Council of Hong Kong.

zh.s: 香港于1967年6月7日举行市政局选举，改选市政局10个民选席位中的5席。

en.t: Israeli forces capture Jerusalem’s Old City during the Six-Day War
en.s: On June 7, 1967, during the Six-Day War, Israeli forces captured Jerusalem’s Old City from Jordanian forces. The capture was part of Israel’s advance in East Jerusalem on the Jordanian front.
en.n: This records the capture of the Old City, rather than the end of the entire Six-Day War.

zh.t: 以军在六日战争中攻占耶路撒冷老城
zh.s: 1967年6月7日，六日战争期间，以色列军队从约旦军队手中夺取耶路撒冷老城。这是以军在东耶路撒冷及约旦战线军事行动的一部分。
zh.n: 此条记录为老城被攻占，并非整个六日战争结束。

en.s: A by-election was held for the Australian House of Representatives seat of Gwydir on 7 June 1969. This was triggered by the resignation of Country Party MP Ian Allan. A by-election for the seat of Bendigo was held on the same day. The by-election was won by Country Party candidate Ralph Hunt.

zh.s: 澳大利亚众议院圭迪尔选区于1969年6月7日举行补选，起因是乡村党议员伊恩·艾伦辞职。同日，班迪戈选区也举行补选。乡村党候选人拉尔夫·亨特赢得席位。

en.s: Operation Apache Snow was a joint United States Army (US Army) and Army of the Republic of Vietnam (ARVN) military operation (10 May – 7 June 1969) during the Vietnam War designed to keep pressure on the People's Army of Vietnam (PAVN) units in the A Sầu Valley and prevent them from mounting any attacks on the neighboring coastal provinces.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 阿帕奇雪行动是美国陆军与越南共和国陆军（南越军队）在越南战争期间联合开展的军事行动，时间为1969年5月10日至6月7日。行动旨在持续向阿绍河谷的越南人民军部队施压，阻止其向邻近沿海省份发动袭击。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: Allegheny Airlines Flight 485 was a regularly scheduled domestic passenger flight between Washington, D.C. and Newport News, Virginia, United States, with three stop-overs, two in Connecticut and a third in Pennsylvania. On June 7, 1971, the Allegheny Airlines Convair CV-580 operating the flight crashed on approach to Tweed New Haven Regional Airport, New Haven County, Connecticut.

zh.t: 阿勒格尼航空485号班机空难
zh.s: 阿勒格尼航空485号班机是一趟定期国内客运航班，往返于美国华盛顿特区和弗吉尼亚州纽波特纽斯之间，中途停靠三站，其中两站位于康涅狄格州，另一站位于宾夕法尼亚州。1971年6月7日，执飞该航班的阿勒格尼航空康维尔CV-580客机在飞往康涅狄格州纽黑文郡特威德纽黑文地区机场时坠毁。

en.s: The Ken Ballew raid was a federal raid on June 7, 1971, on the home of Kenyon F. "Ken" Ballew which became a cause célèbre in the debates between advocates of gun control and advocates of gun ownership rights in the United States.

zh.s: 联邦执法人员于1971年6月7日突袭肯尼恩·F·“肯”·巴卢的住宅。这起突袭后来成为美国控枪支持者与拥枪权利支持者辩论中的焦点事件。

en.t: First Amendment to the United States Constitution
en.s: The First Amendment (Amendment I) to the United States Constitution prevents Congress from making laws respecting an establishment of religion; prohibiting the free exercise of religion; or abridging the freedom of speech, the freedom of the press, the freedom of peaceable assembly and the right to petition the government for redress of grievances. It was adopted on December 15, 1791, as one of the ten amendments that constitute the Bill of Rights.
en.n: The United States Supreme Court overturns the conviction of Paul Cohen for disturbing the peace, setting the precedent that vulgar writing is protected under the First Amendment to the United States Constitution.

zh.s: 美国宪法第一修正案禁止国会立法确立国教、禁止信教自由、限制言论和出版自由、限制和平集会自由，或剥夺民众向政府请愿、要求纠正不公的权利。该修正案于1791年12月15日通过，是构成《权利法案》的十项修正案之一。
zh.n: 美国最高法院推翻了保罗·科恩扰乱治安罪的定罪，确立了粗俗文字受美国宪法第一修正案保护的先例。

en.s: The Battle of Long Khanh (Vietnamese: Trận Long Khánh; 6–7 June 1971) was fought during the Vietnam War between elements of 1st Australian Task Force (1 ATF) and the Viet Cong (VC) and People's Army of Vietnam (PAVN) during Operation Overlord. The fighting saw Australian infantry from 3rd Battalion, Royal Australian Regiment (3 RAR) attack a heavily fortified communist base camp in Long Khanh Province, while Centurion tanks providing close support crushed many bunkers and their occupants.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 隆庆战役（越南语：Trận Long Khánh）于1971年6月6日至7日越南战争期间爆发，交战双方是澳大利亚第一特遣队（1 ATF）部分部队与越共及越南人民军。作战属于“霸王行动”。战斗中，澳大利亚皇家团第3营步兵袭击了共产党军队戒备森严的基地，提供近距离支援的“百人队长”坦克摧毁了许多碉堡及其中的人员。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The 1973 Bristol City Council election took place on 7 June 1973 to elect members of Bristol City Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. Voting took place across 28 wards, each electing 3 Councillors. Following the Local Government Act 1972, this was the first election to the new non-metropolitan district council for Bristol, which came into being on 1 April the following year. Labour took control of the Council after winning a comfortable majority of seats.

zh.s: 英格兰布里斯托尔于1973年6月7日举行市议会选举。选举在28个选区进行，每个选区选出3名议员，并与其他地方选举同日举行。根据《1972年地方政府法》，这是布里斯托尔新设非都市区议会的首次选举；新议会于次年4月1日正式成立。工党赢得明显多数席位，取得议会控制权。

en.s: The 1973 Bracknell District Council election was the first election to the newly formed Bracknell District Council in England, taking place on 7 June 1973 alongside other local elections as part of the 1973 United Kingdom local elections. Its predecessor council was Easthampstead Rural District. For the first time at a local level, the Labour Party gained control.

zh.s: 英格兰新成立的布拉克内尔区议会于1973年6月7日举行首次选举，作为1973年英国地方选举的一部分，与其他地方选举同日进行。其前身是伊斯特汉普斯特德乡村区议会。工党首次在地方层级取得控制权。

en.s: The 1973 Tendring District Council election were the first elections to the newly created Tendring District Council. They took place on 7 June 1973. This was on the same day as other local elections. The Local Government Act 1972 stipulated that the elected members were to shadow and eventually take over from the predecessor corporation on 1 April 1974.

zh.s: 滕德林新设区议会于1973年6月7日举行首次选举，与其他地方选举同日进行。《1972年地方政府法》规定，当选议员先作为影子议会运作，并于1974年4月1日接管前身机构。

en.s: The 1973 Corby District Council election were the first elections to the newly created Corby District Council and took place on 7 June 1973 . This was on the same day as other local elections. The Local Government Act 1972 stipulated that the elected members were to shadow and eventually take over from the predecessor corporation on 1 April 1974.

zh.s: 科比新设区议会于1973年6月7日举行首次选举，与其他地方选举同日进行。《1972年地方政府法》规定，当选议员先作为影子议会运作，并于1974年4月1日接管前身机构。

en.s: Elections to Chichester District Council in West Sussex, United Kingdom were held on 7 June 1973. The whole council was up for election and resulted in no overall control.

zh.s: 英国西萨塞克斯郡奇切斯特区议会于1973年6月7日举行选举，议会全部席位改选。选后没有任何政党单独控制议会。

en.s: The 1973 Basildon Borough Council election were the first elections to the newly created Basildon District Council and took place on 7 June 1973. This was on the same day as other local elections. The Local Government Act 1972 stipulated that the elected members were to shadow and eventually take over from the predecessor corporation on 1 April 1974. The election resulted in Labour gaining control of the council.

zh.s: 巴西尔登新设区议会于1973年6月7日举行首次选举，与其他地方选举同日进行。《1972年地方政府法》规定，当选议员先作为影子议会运作，并于1974年4月1日接管前身机构。工党赢得议会控制权。

en.s: The first elections to the newly created Adur District Council established by the Local Government Act 1972 in England and Wales were held 7 June 1973. Overall turnout was recorded at 46.6%. The election resulted in no overall control.

zh.s: 英格兰和威尔士根据《1972年地方政府法》设立的阿杜尔区议会于1973年6月7日举行首次选举。投票率为46.6%。选后没有任何政党单独控制议会。

en.s: The 1973 Horsham District Council election was the first ever for the council and took place on 7 June 1973 to elect members of Horsham District Council in England. It was held on the same day as other local elections. Independent councillors secured a majority of two with 23 seats, the Conservatives won 17 and the Liberal Party won 2.

zh.s: 霍舍姆区议会于1973年6月7日举行首次选举，与其他地方选举同日进行。无党籍议员赢得23席，领先两席取得多数；保守党赢得17席，自由党赢得2席。

en.s: The 1973 Braintree District Council election took place on 7 June 1973 to elect members of Braintree District Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. This was the inaugural election of Braintree District Council.

zh.s: 英格兰布伦特里区议会于1973年6月7日举行选举，与其他地方选举同日进行。这是布伦特里区议会成立后的首次选举。

en.s: The 1973 Reading District Council election was the first election to the reconstituted Reading Borough Council, which changed from being a county borough to a non-metropolitan district under the Local Government Act 1972. At the time of the election it had yet to be decided whether the new district would hold borough status and so contemporary reports describe the election as being to "Reading District Council", although it was subsequently confirmed that the new council would be a borough. The elections were held on 7 June 1973, in common with other new non-metropolitan district councils in England and Wales.

zh.s: 1973年雷丁区议会选举是重组后的雷丁自治市议会首次选举。根据《1972年地方政府法》，雷丁从郡自治市改为非都市区。当时尚未决定新设区是否享有自治市地位，因此当时的报道称其为“雷丁区议会”；后来才确认新议会为自治市议会。选举于1973年6月7日举行，与英格兰和威尔士其他新设非都市区议会选举同日进行。

en.s: The 1973 Derby Borough Council election took place on 7 June 1973 to elect members of Derby Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. Voting took place across 18 wards, each electing 3 Councillors. Following the Local Government Act 1972, this was the first election to the new non-metropolitan district council for Derby, which came into being on 1 April the following year.

zh.s: 英格兰德比自治市议会于1973年6月7日举行选举，18个选区各选出3名议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。这是德比新设非都市区议会的首次选举；新议会于次年4月1日成立。

en.s: The 1973 Plymouth City Council election took place on 7 June 1973 to elect members of Plymouth City Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. Voting took place across 22 wards, each electing 3 Councillors. Following the Local Government Act 1972, this was the first election to the new non-metropolitan district council for Plymouth, which came into being on 1 April the following year.

zh.s: 英格兰普利茅斯市议会于1973年6月7日举行选举，22个选区各选出3名议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。这是普利茅斯新设非都市区议会的首次选举；新议会于次年4月1日成立。

en.s: The 1973 Fenland District Council election took place on 7 June 1973 to elect members for Fenland District Council in the Isle of Ely, Cambridgeshire, England. The Conservative Party became the largest bloc on the new council, with half the seats.

zh.s: 英格兰剑桥郡伊利岛的Fenland区议会于1973年6月7日举行选举，保守党成为新议会最大党团，赢得一半席位。

en.s: The 1973 Welwyn Hatfield District Council election took place on 7 June 1973 to elect members of Welwyn Hatfield District Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. This was the inaugural election of Welwyn Hatfield District Council. The Labour party secured both a majority of the vote and a slim majority of the total seats, with only the Conservatives picking up any other seats on the council.

zh.t: 1973年韦林哈特菲尔德区议会选举
zh.s: 英格兰韦林哈特菲尔德区议会于1973年6月7日举行首次选举，与其他地方选举同日进行。工党赢得最多选票和略过半数的席位，只有保守党赢得其他议席。

en.s: The 1973 Bassetlaw District Council election took place on 7 June 1973, to elect all 51 members of Bassetlaw District Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The election resulted in the Labour Party winning a majority of seats on the council. This was the first election to elect members of the new district council for Bassetlaw following its creation by the Local Government Act 1972.

zh.s: 英格兰巴塞特洛区议会于1973年6月7日举行选举，改选全部51名议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。工党赢得议会多数席位。这是根据《1972年地方政府法》设立的新区议会首次举行选举。

en.s: The 1973 Thamesdown Borough Council election took place on 7 June 1973 to elect members of Thamesdown Borough Council, a predecessor to Swindon Borough Council in Swindon, Wiltshire, England. It was the first election to the district council, although it acted as a "shadow authority" until 1 April 1974, where it gained full responsibilities as laid out in the Local Government Act 1972.

zh.t: 1973年泰晤士当自治市议会选举
zh.s: 泰晤士当自治市议会于1973年6月7日举行首次选举。该议会是今斯温顿自治市议会的前身，辖区位于英格兰威尔特郡斯温顿。它作为“影子议会”运作，直到1974年4月1日根据《1972年地方政府法》取得全部职权。

en.s: The 1973 City of Lincoln Council election were the first elections to the newly created City of Lincoln Council and took place on 7 June 1973. This was on the same day as other local elections. The Local Government Act 1972 stipulated that the elected members were to shadow and eventually take over from the predecessor corporation on 1 April 1974.

zh.s: 新设林肯市议会于1973年6月7日举行首次选举，与其他地方选举同日进行。《1972年地方政府法》规定，当选议员先作为影子议会运作，并于1974年4月1日接管前身机构。

en.s: The 1973 Harlow District Council election, on 7 June 1973, was the first election to the newly created Harlow District Council. This was on the same day as other local elections. The Local Government Act 1972 stipulated that the elected members were to shadow and eventually take over from the predecessor corporation on 1 April 1974. The election resulted in Labour gaining control of the council.

zh.s: 哈洛新设区议会于1973年6月7日举行首次选举，与其他地方选举同日进行。《1972年地方政府法》规定，当选议员先作为影子议会运作，并于1974年4月1日接管前身机构。工党赢得议会控制权。

en.s: The first election to Mid Bedfordshire District Council was held on 7 June 1973, with the 49 councillors elected forming a shadow authority until 1 April 1974. Mid Bedfordshire District was formed on 1 April 1974 as part of a general reorganisation of local authorities in England and Wales carried out under the Local Government Act 1972.

zh.t: 1973年中贝德福德郡区议会选举
zh.s: 中贝德福德郡区议会于1973年6月7日举行首次选举，选出49名议员组成影子议会，直到1974年4月1日正式履职。中贝德福德郡区根据《1972年地方政府法》进行的英格兰和威尔士地方政府全面改组，于1974年4月1日成立。

en.s: The 1973 Stevenage Borough Council election were the first elections to the newly created Stevenage Borough Council and took place on 7 June 1973 . This was on the same day as other local elections. The Local Government Act 1972 stipulated that the elected members were to shadow and eventually take over from the predecessor urban district council on 1 April 1974.

zh.t: 1973年史蒂夫尼奇自治市议会选举
zh.s: 史蒂夫尼奇新设自治市议会于1973年6月7日举行首次选举，与其他地方选举同日进行。《1972年地方政府法》规定，当选议员先作为影子议会运作，并于1974年4月1日接管前身城市区议会。

en.s: The 1973 North Hertfordshire District Council election was held on 7 June 1973. It was the first election to North Hertfordshire District Council, and was held at the same time as other local elections across England for the new non-metropolitan district councils that were created under the Local Government Act 1972.

zh.t: 1973年北赫特福德郡区议会选举
zh.s: 北赫特福德郡区议会于1973年6月7日举行首次选举，与英格兰其他新设非都市区议会选举同日进行。这些新议会均依据《1972年地方政府法》设立。

en.s: Kerrier was a non-metropolitan district in Cornwall, England, created by the Local Government Act 1972. Elections were held to the new authorities in 1973, and they acted as "shadow authorities" until the handover date. Elections were held on 7 June. All 18 divisions were up for election, covering 42 seats across single and multiple-member wards.

zh.s: 凯里尔是英格兰康沃尔郡一个非都市区，根据《1972年地方政府法》设立。新设地方政府的选举于1973年举行，当选议员先作为影子议会运作，直到正式移交日期。凯里尔于1973年6月7日举行选举，全部18个选区改选，单议员和多议员选区共选出42席。

en.s: The Chicago mayoral election of 1977 was a special election held on June 7, 1977, to complete the remainder of the unexpired mayoral term of Richard J. Daley who died of a heart attack in December 1976. The election saw Interim Mayor Michael A. Bilandic win the election. Bliandic defeated Republican city council member Dennis H. Block by a landslide 56% margin.

zh.s: 芝加哥市长特别选举于1977年6月7日举行，以完成理查德·J·戴利于1976年12月因心脏病去世后未满的任期。代理市长迈克尔·A·比兰迪克当选，以56个百分点的优势击败共和党市议员丹尼斯·H·布洛克。

en.s: The 1979 Irish local elections were held in all the counties, cities and towns of Ireland on 7 June 1979, on the same day as the first direct elections to the European Parliament.

zh.s: 爱尔兰所有郡、市和镇于1979年6月7日举行地方选举，与首次欧洲议会直选同日进行。

en.s: An election to all 28 seats on Donegal County Council took place on 7 June 1979 as part of the 1979 Irish local elections. County Donegal was divided into five county local electoral areas to elect councillors for a five-year term of office on the electoral system of proportional representation by means of the single transferable vote (PR-STV). This term was extended for a further year, to 1985.

zh.s: 爱尔兰多尼戈尔郡议会全部28个席位于1979年6月7日举行选举，作为1979年爱尔兰地方选举的一部分。多尼戈尔郡划分为5个地方选区。选举采用比例代表制单记可转移投票制，议员任期五年。任期后来延长一年，至1985年。

en.s: An election to all 45 seats on the council of Dublin Corporation took place on 7 June 1979 as part of the 1979 Irish local elections. The city of Dublin was divided into 11 borough electoral areas (BEAs) to elect councillors for a five-year term of office on the electoral system of proportional representation by means of the single transferable vote (PR-STV).

zh.s: 都柏林市政公司全部45个议席于1979年6月7日改选，作为1979年爱尔兰地方选举的一部分。都柏林市划分为11个自治市选区，议员任期五年，采用比例代表制单记可转移投票制。

en.s: An election to Sligo County Council took place on 7 June 1979 as part of that year's Irish local elections. 24 councillors were elected from four local electoral areas (LEAs) for a six-year term of office on the electoral system of proportional representation by means of the single transferable vote (PR-STV).

zh.s: 爱尔兰斯莱戈郡议会全部24个席位于1979年6月7日举行选举，作为1979年爱尔兰地方选举的一部分。选举从4个地方选区选出24名议员。选举采用比例代表制单记可转移投票制，议员任期六年。

en.s: An election to all 26 seats on Kerry County Council took place on 7 June 1979 as part of that year's Irish local elections. Councillors were elected from 4 local electoral areas (LEAs) on the electoral system of proportional representation by means of the single transferable vote (PR-STV).

zh.s: 爱尔兰凯里郡议会全部26个席位于1979年6月7日举行选举，作为1979年爱尔兰地方选举的一部分。议员从4个地方选区选出。选举采用比例代表制单记可转移投票制。

en.t: 1979 European Parliament election in the Netherlands
en.s: An election for Members of the European Parliament representing Netherlands constituency for the 1979–1984 term of the European Parliament was held on 7 June 1979. It was part of the wider 1979 European election.

zh.s: 荷兰于1979年6月7日举行欧洲议会议员选举，选出代表荷兰参加1979—1984年欧洲议会任期的议员。这是1979年欧洲议会选举的一部分。

en.s: An election to all 21 seats on Wicklow County Council took place on 7 June 1979 as part of the 1979 Irish local elections. County Wicklow was divided into 4 county electoral areas to elect councillors for a five-year term of office on the electoral system of proportional representation by means of the single transferable vote (PR-STV). The term was extended to 1985.

zh.s: 爱尔兰威克洛郡议会全部21个席位于1979年6月7日举行选举，作为1979年爱尔兰地方选举的一部分。威克洛郡划分为4个郡级选区。选举采用比例代表制单记可转移投票制，议员任期五年。任期后来延长至1985年。

en.s: Early parliamentary elections were held in Egypt on 7 June 1979, with a second round for 147 seats being held on 14 June. Following the experimental 1976 elections, in which three different factions of the Arab Socialist Union had competed against each other, the country had returned to multi-party politics. This was confirmed in a referendum on the formation of new parties held in April.

zh.s: 埃及于1979年6月7日提前举行议会选举，147个席位于6月14日进行第二轮投票。1976年试验性选举曾由阿拉伯社会主义联盟的三个派别相互竞争；此后埃及恢复多党政治，并于4月举行公投确认成立新政党的安排。

en.s: The 1979 European Parliament election in Ireland was the Irish component of the 1979 European Parliament election. These were the first direct elections to the European Parliament, and the first election to be held simultaneously across the entire Island of Ireland since the 1921 Irish elections. The election was conducted under the single transferable vote.

zh.s: 1979年爱尔兰欧洲议会选举是1979年欧洲议会选举在爱尔兰举行的部分，也是欧洲议会首次直接选举。此次选举是自1921年以来首次在爱尔兰全岛同步举行的选举，采用单记可转移投票制。

en.t: 1979 European Parliament election in the United Kingdom
en.s: The 1979 European Parliament election, was the first European election to be held in the United Kingdom after the European Communities (EC) decided to directly elect representatives to the European Parliament. It was held on 7 June. Elections were also held in eight other EC states. European elections were incorporated into UK law by the European Assembly Elections Act 1978.

zh.s: 1979年欧洲议会选举是欧洲共同体决定直接选举欧洲议会议员后，英国举行的首场欧洲选举。选举于6月7日举行，欧洲共同体另外八个成员国也举行了选举。英国通过《1978年欧洲议会选举法》将欧洲选举纳入本国法律。

en.s: The Onehunga by-election of 1980 was a by-election for the Onehunga electorate during the 39th New Zealand Parliament. It was prompted by the death of Frank Rogers, a Labour Party MP. It was held on 7 June 1980 and was won by Fred Gerbic, also of the Labour Party.

zh.s: 新西兰第39届议会奥尼洪加选区于1980年6月7日举行补选，起因是工党议员弗兰克·罗杰斯去世。工党候选人弗雷德·格比克赢得补选。

en.s: The 1980 Coupe de France final was a football match held at Parc des Princes, Paris, on 7 June 1980 that saw AS Monaco FC defeat US Orléans of Division 2 3–1 thanks to goals by Albert Emon and Delio Onnis.

zh.s: 1980年法国杯决赛于1980年6月7日在巴黎王子公园球场举行。摩纳哥足球俱乐部以3比1击败乙级球队奥尔良美国队，阿尔贝·埃蒙和德利奥·奥尼斯为摩纳哥进球。

en.s: The 1980 Taça de Portugal final was the final match of the 1979–80 Taça de Portugal, the 40th season of the Taça de Portugal, the premier Portuguese football cup competition organized by the Portuguese Football Federation (FPF). The match was played on 7 June 1980 at the Estádio Nacional in Oeiras, and opposed two Primeira Liga sides: Benfica and Porto.

zh.s: 1980年葡萄牙杯决赛是1979—1980赛季葡萄牙杯的决赛，也是由葡萄牙足球协会主办的葡萄牙顶级杯赛第40个赛季的收官战。比赛于1980年6月7日在奥埃拉什的国家体育场举行，由葡超球队本菲卡和波尔图交手。

en.s: A general election was held in the Northern Territory on Saturday June 7, 1980. It was the first to be held since self-government was attained two years earlier, and was won by the incumbent Country Liberal Party (CLP) under Chief Minister Paul Everingham. Although the CLP's share of the vote increased by almost 10 percentage points, it lost one seat.

zh.s: 澳大利亚北领地于1980年6月7日（星期六）举行大选。这是该地区于两年前取得自治后首次举行大选。由首席部长保罗·埃弗林厄姆领导的执政乡村自由党获胜。该党得票率上升近10个百分点，但席位减少1席。

en.s: The Northern Maori by-election of 1980 was a by-election for the Northern Maori electorate during the 39th New Zealand Parliament. It was prompted on 29 April by the resignation of Matiu Rata, a former member of the Labour Party who was establishing a new group, Mana Motuhake. Rata believed that contesting a by-election would give him a mandate for his change of allegiance.

zh.s: 1980年北毛利选区补选是新西兰第39届议会期间举行的一次补选。工党议员马蒂乌·拉塔于4月29日辞职，准备组建新团体Mana Motuhake，因此触发补选。拉塔认为，参加补选可以为他改变政治立场争取选民授权。

en.s: The 1981 Belgian Cup final, took place on 7 June 1981 between Standard Liège and Sporting Lokeren. It was the 26th Belgian Cup final and Standard Liège won the match 4-0.

zh.s: 1981年比利时杯决赛于1981年6月7日举行，由标准列日队对阵洛克伦体育队。这是比利时杯第26届决赛，标准列日以4比0获胜。

en.s: The Battle of Fakashan (Chinese: 法卡山戰役), also known as the Battle of Hill 400, was fought in 1981 between China and Vietnam as part of the Sino-Vietnamese conflicts (1979–1991).

zh.s: 法卡山之战又称400高地之战，1981年中国与越南在中越边境冲突期间交战。
zh.n: 本条记录的是原文资料框所列战斗的结束日期。

en.s: The 1982 Yukon general election was held on June 7, 1982, to elect members of the 25th Legislative Assembly of the territory of Yukon, Canada. It was won by the Progressive Conservatives.

zh.s: 加拿大育空地区于1982年6月7日举行大选，选出地区第25届立法议会议员。进步保守党获胜。

en.t: Graceland opens to the public for tours
en.s: On June 7, 1982, Graceland, Elvis Presley’s former home in Memphis, Tennessee, opened to the public for tours. The opening allowed visitors to explore the mansion where Presley had lived.

zh.t: 猫王故居雅园向公众开放
zh.s: 1982年6月7日，埃尔维斯·普雷斯利（猫王）位于美国田纳西州孟菲斯的故居雅园开始向公众开放。游客从此可以进入这座他曾居住的宅邸参观。

en.s: The 1987 Taça de Portugal final was the final match of the 1986–87 Taça de Portugal. It was the 47th season of the Taça de Portugal, the premier Portuguese football cup competition organized by the Portuguese Football Federation (FPF). The match was played on 7 June 1987 at the Estádio Nacional in Oeiras, and opposed two Primeira Liga sides: Benfica and Sporting CP.

zh.s: 1987年葡萄牙杯决赛是1986—1987赛季葡萄牙杯的决赛，也是由葡萄牙足球协会主办的葡萄牙顶级杯赛第47个赛季的收官战。比赛于1987年6月7日在奥埃拉什的国家体育场举行，由葡超球队本菲卡和里斯本竞技交手。

en.s: The 1988 San Diego mayoral election was held on June 7, 1988, to elect the mayor for San Diego. Incumbent mayor Maureen O'Connor stood for reelection. Municipal elections in California are officially non-partisan, though some candidates do receive funding and support from various political parties. The non-partisan primary was held June 7, 1988. Since the incumbent O'Connor received a majority of the primary votes, she was reelected outright with no need for a runoff.

zh.s: 加利福尼亚州圣迭戈市于1988年6月7日举行市长选举，时任市长莫琳·奥康纳竞选连任。加州市政选举在法律上不设党派，不过一些候选人会获得政党的资金和支持。无党派初选于1988年6月7日举行。由于奥康纳在初选中获得多数选票，她直接连任，无需决选。

en.t: Irvine holds its first direct mayoral election
en.s: On June 7, 1988, Irvine, California, held its first direct mayoral election. Incumbent mayor Larry Agran won the officially nonpartisan vote.

zh.s: 1988年6月7日，加利福尼亚州尔湾市首次由选民直接选出市长。时任市长拉里·阿格兰在这场不按党派划分的选举中当选。

en.s: Surinam Airways Flight 764 was an international scheduled passenger flight of Surinam Airways from Amsterdam Airport Schiphol in the Netherlands to Paramaribo-Zanderij International Airport in Suriname. On 7 June 1989, the DC-8-62 serving the flight crashed during approach to Paramaribo-Zanderij, killing 178 of the 187 on board. It is the deadliest aviation disaster in Suriname's history. Investigation revealed significant deficiencies in the crew's training and judgement.

zh.t: 苏里南航空764号班机空难
zh.s: 苏里南航空764号班机是一趟国际定期客运航班，从荷兰阿姆斯特丹史基浦机场飞往苏里南帕拉马里博约翰·阿道夫·彭格尔国际机场。1989年6月7日，执飞该航班的DC-8-62客机在飞往帕拉马里博途中降落时坠毁，机上187人中有178人遇难。这是苏里南历史上死亡人数最多的空难。调查发现，机组人员的训练和判断存在严重缺陷。

en.s: The 1992 Belgian Cup final took place on 7 June 1992 between Royal Antwerp and KV Mechelen and was the 37th Belgian Cup final. Both clubs got a chance to win their second Belgian Cup, after Antwerp had already won in 1955, while Mechelen was victorious in 1987. The match ended in a 2–2 draw after extra time and was won by Antwerp on penalty kicks (9–8).

zh.s: 1992年比利时杯决赛于1992年6月7日举行，由皇家安特卫普队对阵梅赫伦KV队。这是比利时杯第37届决赛。两支球队都有机会第二次夺冠：安特卫普曾于1955年夺冠，梅赫伦则曾于1987年夺冠。比赛在加时赛后以2比2战平，安特卫普最终以9比8的点球比分获胜。

en.s: The 1994 Oakland mayoral election was held on June 7, 1994, and November 8, 1994, to elect the mayor of Oakland, California. It saw the reelection of Elihu Harris. Since no candidate secured a majority in the first round, a runoff election was held between the top-two finishers, Harris and Ted Dang.

zh.s: 加利福尼亚州奥克兰市于1994年6月7日和11月8日举行市长选举，埃利胡·哈里斯连任。首轮无人获得多数选票，得票最高的两名候选人哈里斯和特德·当进入决选。

en.s: The 1994 San Jose mayoral election was held on June 7, 1994, to elect the mayor of San Jose, California. It saw the reelection of Susan Hammer. Because Hammer won an outright majority in the initial round of the election, no runoff election needed to be held.

zh.s: 加利福尼亚州圣何塞市于1994年6月7日举行市长选举，苏珊·哈默连任。由于哈默在首轮投票中直接获得多数，无需举行决选。

en.s: The Trofeo Arena Coliseo, commonly referred to as the Torneo Gran Alternativa (June 1996) (Spanish for "Great Alternative Tournament"), was a CMLL Torneo Gran Alternativa professional wrestling tournament held by the Mexican professional wrestling promotion Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLL; Spanish for "World Wrestling Council"). The tournament was held on June 7, 1996, in Mexico City, Mexico at CMLL's secondary venue, Arena Coliseo.

zh.s: 《竞技场杯》赛事通常称为1996年6月《伟大新秀锦标赛》，是墨西哥摔角推广组织世界摔角理事会（CMLL）举办的一场职业摔角锦标赛，于1996年6月7日在墨西哥城的CMLL第二场馆竞技场举行。

en.s: The Guinea-Bissau Civil War was fought from 7 June 1998 to 10 May 1999 and was triggered by an attempted coup d'état against the government of President João Bernardo Vieira led by Brigadier-General Ansumane Mané. Government forces, backed by neighbouring states, clashed with the coup leaders who had quickly gained almost total control over the country's armed forces. The conflict resulted in the deaths of hundreds if not thousands of people and the displacement of hundreds of thousands. An eventual peace agreement in November 1998 provided for a national unity government and new elections in the next year.

zh.s: 几内亚比绍内战于1998年6月7日至1999年5月10日进行，起因是安苏马内·马内准将试图发动政变，推翻若昂·贝尔纳多·维埃拉总统政府。政府军在邻国支持下与政变领导人交战；政变领导人很快几乎完全控制了该国武装部队。冲突造成数百乃至数千人死亡，数十万人流离失所。双方最终于1998年11月达成和平协议，成立民族团结政府，并在次年举行大选。

en.s: Triplemanía VI was the sixth Triplemanía professional wrestling show promoted by AAA. 1998 was the first year since 1993 to only feature one Triplemanía event. The show took place on June 7, 1998 at Gymnasio Manual Bernardo Aguirre in Chihuahua, Chihuahua, Mexico. The Main event featured a singles match between Kick Boxer and Heavy Metal where each man represented an AAA referee who put his hair on the line.

en.s: The 1998 Guinea-Bissau coup attempt was the attempted military overthrow in Guinea-Bissau by dissident elements within the military against the João Bernardo Vieira government. en.s: The United Kingdom general election, 2001, was held on Thursday, 7 June 2001, to elect 659 members to the British House of Commons. It was dubbed "the quiet landslide" by the media, as the Labour Party was re-elected with another landslide result and only suffered a net loss of five seats, though with significantly lower turnout than before – 59.4%, compared to 71.3% in the previous election. Tony Blair went on to become the first Labour Prime Minister to serve a second consecutive full term in office. There was little change outside Northern Ireland, with 620 out of the 641 seats electing candidates from the same party as they did in 1997.

en.s: The 2001 Buckinghamshire Council election took place on 7 June 2001 to elect members of Buckinghamshire County Council in England. en.s: Local elections took place in some parts of the UK on 7 June 2001. en.s: On Thursday 7 June 2001, the 2001 United Kingdom general election was held in Wales, to elect all 659 members of the House of Commons, with 40 constituencies being in Wales. en.s: The 2001 Cornwall County Council election, was an election for all 79 seats on the council. Cornwall County Council was a county council that covered the majority of the ceremonial county of Cornwall, with the exception of the Isles of Scilly which had an independent local authority. The elections took place concurrently with other local elections across England and Northern Ireland.

zh.s: 2001年康沃尔郡郡议会选举改选议会全部79个席位。康沃尔郡郡议会覆盖康沃尔礼仪郡的大部分地区，锡利群岛除外；锡利群岛由独立地方政府管理。选举与英格兰和北爱尔兰其他地方选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2003 Insurrextion was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by the American promotion World Wrestling Entertainment (WWE) and broadcast exclusively in the United Kingdom. It was the fourth annual and final Insurrextion and took place on June 7, 2003, at the Telewest Arena in Newcastle, England, held exclusively for wrestlers from the promotion's Raw brand division. Seven matches were contested at the event, with two dark matches.

zh.s: 2003年《起义》是美国摔角推广组织世界摔角娱乐（WWE）主办的职业摔角付费点播赛事，仅在英国播出。这是该系列第4届、也是最后一届赛事，于2003年6月7日在英格兰纽卡斯尔的泰莱威斯特竞技场举行，参赛者仅来自Raw品牌。赛事共安排7场比赛，另有两场暗赛。

en.s: On May 7 and June 7, 2005, the city of San Antonio, Texas held an election to choose who would serve as Mayor of San Antonio for a two-year term to expire in 2007. Phil Hardberger won in a runoff against Julian Castro. The election was officially nonpartisan.

zh.s: 得克萨斯州圣安东尼奥市于2005年5月7日和6月7日举行市长选举，选出任期两年的市长，任期至2007年届满。菲尔·哈德伯格在决选中击败朱利安·卡斯特罗。选举在法律上不设党派。

en.s: An indirect presidential election was held in Hungary on 6–7 June 2005. Incumbent President Ferenc Mádl, was eligible for a second term, but did not seek for re-election. Former President of the Constitutional Court László Sólyom was elected with an absolute majority. This was the closest election since 1990 and the last one which was not won by the candidate of the ruling party.

zh.s: 匈牙利于2005年6月6日至7日举行间接总统选举。时任总统马德尔·费伦茨有资格连任，但没有寻求连任。前宪法法院院长绍约姆·拉斯洛以绝对多数当选。这是1990年以来竞争最激烈的一次选举，也是最后一次由执政党候选人落败的总统选举。

en.s: WWE vs ECW Head-to-Head was a professional wrestling television special event produced by World Wrestling Entertainment (WWE). It was held on June 7, 2006 at the Nutter Center in Dayton, Ohio. The event, which aired on the USA Network, served as a preview show for the ECW One Night Stand pay-per-view, airing only four days before that event. The event was themed around matches between wrestlers from WWE's Raw and SmackDown!

zh.s: WWE对阵ECW是一场由世界摔角娱乐（WWE）制作的职业摔角电视特别节目，于2006年6月7日在俄亥俄州代顿的纳特中心举行，并在USA电视网播出。该节目是《ECW一夜情》付费点播赛事的预热节目，后者于四天后播出。节目安排了WWE旗下Raw和SmackDown品牌摔角手之间的比赛。

en.s: The 2006 Oakland mayoral election was held on June 7, 2006 to elect the mayor of Oakland, California. It saw the election of Ron Dellums. Incumbent mayor Jerry Brown did not seek reelection to a third term, instead opting to run in the 2006 California Attorney General election. A 50% margin of the vote needed to be obtained by the victor in order to avoid a runoff being held in November.

zh.s: 加利福尼亚州奥克兰市于2006年6月7日举行市长选举，罗恩·戴勒姆斯当选。时任市长杰里·布朗没有竞选第三个任期，而是转而参加2006年加州总检察长选举。候选人必须获得50%的选票才能避免在11月举行决选。

en.s: Operation Tiger Hammer was part of the Iraq War that began in 2003. Iraqi Army soldiers conducted a battalion-sized cordon and search operation in the Adhamiyah District of the Iraqi capital 7 June. The combined mission, dubbed Operation Tiger Hammer, was conducted by elements of the 1st and 3rd battalions of the 1st Brigade, 11th Iraqi Army Division with support provided by Multi-National Division – Baghdad Soldiers from Company C, 1st Battalion, 26th Infantry Regiment, operating in Baghdad with the 2nd Brigade Combat Team, 82nd Airborne Division.

zh.s: 虎锤行动是伊拉克战争的一部分。2007年6月7日，伊拉克军队士兵在伊拉克首都巴格达的阿达米亚区执行营级封锁与搜查行动。行动由伊拉克陆军第11师第1旅第1营和第3营部队实施，巴格达多国师士兵提供支援；支援部队来自美国陆军第82空降师第2旅战斗队第26步兵团第1营C连。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Niue on June 7, 2008. They were initially expected to be held in April, but were delayed until June 2008. Niue has a 20-member legislative assembly, called the Niue Assembly, whose members are elected by approximately 600 registered voters.

zh.s: 纽埃于2008年6月7日举行议会选举，最初预计在4月举行，后来推迟到6月。纽埃立法议会有20名成员，约600名登记选民选出议员。

en.s: Respect Is Earned II was a professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by Ring of Honor. It took place on June 7, 2008 from the Pennsylvania National Guard Armory in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. It did not, however, air on pay-per-view until August 1.

zh.s: 《赢得尊重II》是荣誉之戒摔角联盟主办的职业摔角付费点播赛事，于2008年6月7日在宾夕法尼亚州费城的宾夕法尼亚国民警卫队军械库举行，但直到8月1日才通过付费点播播出。

en.s: Extreme Rules (2009) was a professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by World Wrestling Entertainment (WWE), which took place on June 7, 2009, at the New Orleans Arena in New Orleans, Louisiana. It was presented by AT&T. It was the first event promoted under the Extreme Rules name, and initially noted by WWE to be a direct continuation of the One Night Stand chronology. It featured talent from the Raw, SmackDown, and ECW brands. There were eight matches scheduled on the event's card, though nine actually took place. The main event was a Ladder match for the World Heavyweight Championship, which saw Jeff Hardy defeat the reigning champion Edge to win the title.

zh.s: 2009年《极限规则》是世界摔角娱乐（WWE）主办的职业摔角付费点播赛事，于2009年6月7日在路易斯安那州新奥尔良竞技场举行，由AT&T赞助。这是首次以“极限规则”命名的赛事；WWE最初将其称为《一夜情》系列的直接延续。赛事选手来自Raw、SmackDown和ECW品牌。赛程安排了8场比赛，实际举行了9场。主赛是世界重量级冠军梯子赛，杰夫·哈迪击败卫冕冠军埃奇，赢得冠军。

en.s: A primary election was held among the members of Costa Rica’s then ruling National Liberation Party (PLN) on June 7, 2009 in order to choose the PLN’s nominee for presidency in the 2010 general election. The two main candidates for the nomination were then vice-president Laura Chinchilla and San José Mayor Johnny Araya. Former security minister Fernando Berrocal also ran a basically testimonial candidacy. PLN’s main rival party, PAC, ran its own convention a month before. PLN primaries, known as National Conventions (Convención Nacional Liberacionista) were common place since the Party’s foundation, yet in the previous election of 2006 PLN’s nominee former president Óscar Arias seeking re-election ran unappose and was designated by the party’s National Assembly.

zh.s: 哥斯达黎加当时执政的国家解放党（PLN）于2009年6月7日举行党内初选，选出参加2010年大选的总统候选人。主要竞争者是时任副总统劳拉·钦奇利亚和圣何塞市长约翰尼·阿拉亚。前安全部长费尔南多·贝罗卡尔也参选，但基本只是象征性竞选。PLN的初选称为“全国解放党大会”，自该党成立以来一直很常见；但在2006年上次选举中，该党候选人、寻求连任的前总统奥斯卡·阿里亚斯无人竞争，由全国议会直接提名。

en.s: Regional elections were held in Belgium on 7 June 2009 to choose representatives in the regional parliaments of Flanders, Wallonia, Brussels and the German-speaking Community of Belgium. These elections were held on the same day as the European elections. The Parliament of the French Community is composed of all elected members of the Walloon Parliament (except German-speakers) and 19 of the French-speaking members of the Brussels Parliament.

zh.s: 比利时于2009年6月7日举行大区选举，选出佛兰德、瓦隆、布鲁塞尔和比利时德语区各自大区议会的代表。选举与欧洲议会选举同日进行。法语社群议会由瓦隆议会当选议员（德语区议员除外）以及布鲁塞尔议会19名法语议员组成。

en.s: European Parliament elections were held in Greece on 7 June 2009 to elect the 22 Greek members of the European Parliament. Members were elected by party-list proportional representation with a 3% electoral threshold. The number of seats allocated to Greece was reduced from 24 to 22, as a result of new member states joining the European Union (EU).

zh.s: 希腊于2009年6月7日举行欧洲议会选举，选出22名希腊欧洲议会议员。选举采用政党名单比例代表制，门槛为3%。由于欧盟接纳新成员国，希腊分配的席位从24席减至22席。

en.s: An election was held in Spain on 7 June 2009 as part of the concurrent EU-wide election to the 7th European Parliament. All 50 seats allocated to the Spanish constituency as per the Treaty of Nice—54 after the Treaty of Lisbon came into force on 1 December 2011—were up for election.

zh.s: 西班牙于2009年6月7日举行欧洲议会选举，作为欧盟同期选举的一部分，选出第七届欧洲议会代表。根据《尼斯条约》，西班牙选区原有50个席位改选；《里斯本条约》于2011年12月1日生效后，席位增至54个。

en.s: An election of the delegation from Poland to the European Parliament was held on 7 June 2009. On 13 February the Sejm (the lower house of the Polish parliament) accepted a proposal for an amendment to the electoral court act to allow voting for the European Parliament election of 2009 to take place over 2 days i.e. the 6 and 7 June 2009.

zh.s: 波兰于2009年6月7日举行欧洲议会选举，选出该国代表。2月13日，波兰众议院通过一项修改选举法的提案，允许2009年欧洲议会选举分两天举行，即6月6日和7日。

en.s: The election of the delegation from Bulgaria to the European Parliament was held on Sunday, 7 June 2009. As a result of the Treaty of Nice – that became active in November 2004 – the number of Bulgarian delegates in the European Parliament decreased from 18 (in 2007) to 17 delegates. When the Treaty of Lisbon was ratified, the number of Bulgarian Delegates increased to 18 again, giving a second seat to the Blue Coalition.

zh.s: 保加利亚于2009年6月7日（星期日）举行欧洲议会选举，选出该国代表。根据2004年11月生效的《尼斯条约》，保加利亚在欧洲议会的席位从2007年的18席减至17席。《里斯本条约》获批准后，保加利亚议员席位又增至18席，蓝色联盟因此多获得一个席位。

en.s: European Parliament elections were held in Denmark on 7 June 2009 to elect the 13 Danish members of the European Parliament. The election was held simultaneously with a referendum on changing the Danish Act of Succession.

zh.s: 丹麦于2009年6月7日举行欧洲议会选举，选出13名丹麦籍欧洲议会议员。选举与是否修改《丹麦王位继承法》的公投同时举行。

en.s: The 2009 European Parliament election in Italy was held on Saturday 6 and Sunday 7 June 2009, as decided by the Italian government on 18 December 2008. Italy elected 72 members of the European Parliament (MEPs).

zh.s: 意大利政府于2008年12月18日决定，2009年欧洲议会选举在意大利于6月6日（星期六）和7日（星期日）举行。意大利选出72名欧洲议会议员。

en.s: An election for Members of the European Parliament from Estonia to the European Parliament was held on 7 June 2009. Turnout was 43.9% – about 17.1% higher than during the previous election five years before. The turnout was also slightly above the European average of 42.94%. Six seats were up for taking in this election: two of them were won by the Estonian Centre Party.

zh.s: 爱沙尼亚于2009年6月7日举行欧洲议会选举。投票率为43.9%，比五年前上次选举高约17.1%，也略高于欧洲平均投票率42.94%。本次选举改选6席，爱沙尼亚中间党赢得其中2席。

en.s: An election of the delegation from Portugal to the European Parliament was held on 7 June 2009. In a surprise upset, the Social Democrats (PSD) were the big winners of this election, debunking forecasts of a very complicated result for then PSD leader, Manuela Ferreira Leite, just a few months before the legislative election. The PSD won 31.7 percent of the vote and 8 seats.

zh.s: 葡萄牙于2009年6月7日举行欧洲议会选举，选出该国代表。社会民主党（PSD）出人意料地赢得选举，推翻了此前对该党领袖曼努埃拉·费雷拉·莱特在几个月后立法选举中将面临艰难局面的预测。社会民主党获得31.7%的选票和8个席位。

en.s: The 2009 European Parliament election in Sweden was held on 7 June 2009 and determined the makeup of the Swedish delegation to the European Parliament. The election was held using a modified form of the Sainte-Laguë method of party-list proportional representation using the entire country as a single electoral constituency.

zh.s: 瑞典于2009年6月7日举行欧洲议会选举，决定瑞典代表团的组成。选举以瑞典全国为单一选区，采用经过调整的圣拉古法政党名单比例代表制。

en.s: An election of the delegation from Belgium to the European Parliament was held on Sunday, 7 June 2009. The elections were on the same day as regional elections to the Flemish Parliament, Walloon Parliament, Brussels Parliament and the Parliament of the German-speaking Community.

zh.s: 比利时于2009年6月7日（星期日）举行欧洲议会选举，选出该国代表。选举与佛兰德议会、瓦隆议会、布鲁塞尔议会和德语社群议会选举同日举行。

en.s: WEC 41: Brown vs. Faber 2 was a mixed martial arts event held by World Extreme Cagefighting on June 7, 2009 at the Arco Arena in Sacramento, California. It was the most successful show in the WEC's history.

zh.s: WEC 41：布朗对阵费伯二番战是世界极限笼斗联盟于2009年6月7日在加利福尼亚州萨克拉门托阿科体育馆举办的一场综合格斗赛事。这是该联盟历史上最成功的一场赛事。

en.s: The 2009 Saarland local elections were held on June 7, 2009 to elect members of Saarland's district councils and municipal councils. The elections were held on the same day as the 2009 European Parliament election in Germany.

zh.s: 萨尔州于2009年6月7日举行地方选举，选举萨尔州各县议会和市镇议会议员。选举与2009年德国欧洲议会选举同日进行。

en.s: The 2009 European Parliament election was held in the 27 member states of the European Union (EU) between 4 and 7 June 2009. A total of 736 Members of the European Parliament (MEPs) were elected to represent some 500 million Europeans, making these the biggest trans-national elections in history. An additional 18 observers ("virtual MEPs") were (supposed to be) pre-elected.

zh.s: 2009年欧洲议会选举于6月4日至7日在欧盟27个成员国举行，共选出736名欧洲议会议员，代表约5亿欧洲人，是历史上规模最大的跨国选举。原计划还预先选出另外18名观察员（“虚拟议员”）。

en.s: An election of Members of the European Parliament from Hungary to the European Parliament was held in 2009. Hungary delegated 22 members to the European Parliament based on the Nice treaty and the election took place on 7 June.

zh.s: 匈牙利于2009年6月7日举行欧洲议会选举，选出该国代表。根据《尼斯条约》，匈牙利向欧洲议会派出22名议员。

en.s: An election of the delegation from Finland to the European Parliament was held in 2009. Finland uses the open list D'Hondt method, where voters vote for an individual, but the individual's vote is counted primarily for the party and secondarily for the candidate. Parties receive seats in proportion to their share of the vote, and candidates from those parties are selected based on the votes they received individually.

zh.s: 芬兰于2009年举行欧洲议会选举，选出该国代表。芬兰采用开放名单顿特法：选民投票给个人候选人，但选票首先计入政党，其次才计入候选人。政党按得票比例分配席位，党内候选人再根据各自得票数当选。

en.s: The German part of the 2009 European Parliament election was held on Sunday, 7 June. A total of 26 parties competed for the 99 seats reserved for Germany in the European Parliament. In the previous election of 2004, the six parties which were represented in the German national parliament (Bundestag) from 2005 to 2013, had entered the European Parliament by overcoming the 5% election threshold.

zh.s: 德国于2009年6月7日（星期日）举行欧洲议会选举，26个政党竞争德国在欧洲议会的99个席位。2004年上次选举中，德国联邦议院在2005年至2013年期间有代表的6个政党均突破5%的选举门槛，进入欧洲议会。

en.t: Austria votes in the 2009 European Parliament election
en.s: On June 7, 2009, Austria voted in the European Parliament election to choose 17 members. Voting across the European Union took place over several days, rather than on one shared national polling day.
en.n: Austria’s polling day was June 7, rather than the June 4 start of voting elsewhere in Europe.

zh.n: 奥地利的投票日为6月7日，并非欧洲其他国家开始投票的6月4日。

en.s: The 2011 Denver mayoral election took place on May 3 and June 7, 2011, to elect the Mayor of Denver. It led to a run-off election on June 7, 2011, which was won by Michael Hancock. en.s: Verano de Escándalo (2014) (Spanish for "Summer of Scandal") was a professional wrestling event produced by the Asistencia Asesoría y Administración (AAA) promotion, which took place on June 7, 2014, at Plaza de Toros la Concordia in Orizaba, Veracruz, Mexico. The event has been AAA's annual summer show since 1997, though this marked the first time the event had taken place since 2011. The event featured six matches and was headlined by the AAA in-ring debut of former Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre and WWE wrestler Myzteziz.

zh.s: 2014年《丑闻之夏》（西班牙语意为“丑闻之夏”）是AAA摔角联盟主办的职业摔角赛事，于2014年6月7日在墨西哥韦拉克鲁斯州奥里萨巴的协和斗牛场举行。该赛事自1997年起成为AAA的年度夏季赛事，但2014年这届是其自2011年以来首次举办。赛事共安排6场比赛，主赛是前世界摔角理事会和WWE摔角手米兹特兹首次在AAA擂台亮相。
