en.s: The 2014 Malaysia FA Cup final was a football match which was played on 7 June 2014, to determine the champion of the 2014 Malaysia FA Cup. The final was played between Pahang and Felda United. Pahang won 2–1 to win their second Malaysia FA Cup title after winning it in 2006, thus qualifying for the group stage of the 2015 AFC Cup.

zh.s: 2014年马来西亚足总杯决赛于2014年6月7日举行，决出当届冠军。彭亨队以2比1击败费尔达联队，第二次夺得马来西亚足总杯冠军；该队此前于2006年夺冠。彭亨队因此获得2015年亚足联杯小组赛资格。

en.t: UFC Fight Night: Henderson vs. Khabilov
en.s: UFC Fight Night: Henderson vs. Khabilov (also known as UFC Fight Night 42) was a mixed martial arts event held on June 7, 2014, at Tingley Coliseum in Albuquerque, New Mexico.

zh.t: UFC格斗之夜：亨德森对阵哈比洛夫
zh.s: UFC格斗之夜：亨德森对阵哈比洛夫又称UFC格斗之夜42，是一场综合格斗赛事，于2014年6月7日在新墨西哥州阿尔伯克基的廷利体育馆举行。

en.s: The 2014 Christy Ring Cup final was a hurling match played at Croke Park on 7 June 2014 to determine the winners of the 2014 Christy Ring Cup, the 10th season of the Christy Ring Cup, a tournament organised by the Gaelic Athletic Association for the second tier hurling teams. The final was contested by Kerry of Munster and Kildare of Leinster, with Kildare winning by 4-18 to 2-22.

zh.s: 2014年克里斯蒂·林杯决赛是一场盖尔式曲棍球比赛，于2014年6月7日在克罗克公园举行，决出该项赛事第10个赛季冠军。克里郡芒斯特队对阵基尔代尔郡伦斯特队，基尔代尔队以4-18比2-22获胜。该赛事由盖尔运动协会为第二级别曲棍球队伍举办。

"The Cage of the Crazy Ones", a reference to the Spanish title of La Cage aux Folles) was a special professional wrestling event produced by the International Wrestling Revolution Group (IWRG), that took place on June 7, 2015 at Arena Naucalpan in Naucalpan, State of Mexico.

zh.s: 《疯人笼》（西班牙语字面意为“疯子的笼子”，借指西班牙语片名《疯女之笼》）是国际摔角革命集团（IWRG）举办的一场职业摔角特别赛事，于2015年6月7日在墨西哥州瑙卡尔潘的瑙卡尔潘竞技场举行。

en.s: The 2015 Guerrero state elections were held on Sunday 7 June 2015, with the following positions being renewed: Governors of Guerrero. Head of the Executive Branch of the state, elected for a period of six years, not re-electable in any case. 46 deputies to the Congress of Guerrero. 28 elected by relative majority in each of the Electoral Districts and 18 elected by the principle of proportional representation through a list system.

zh.s: 墨西哥格雷罗州于2015年6月7日（星期日）举行州选举，改选州长和格雷罗州议会46名议员。州长作为州行政部门首长，任期六年，不得连任。州议会中28席由各选区相对多数选出，另18席按比例代表制政党名单选出。

en.s: General elections were held in Turkey on 7 June 2015 to elect 550 members to the Grand National Assembly. This was the 24th general election in the history of the Turkish Republic, electing the country's 25th Parliament. The result was the first hung parliament since the 1999 general elections. Unsuccessful attempts to form a coalition government resulted in a snap general election being called for November 2015.

zh.s: 土耳其于2015年6月7日举行大选，选出大国民议会550名议员。这是土耳其共和国历史上第24次大选，选出第25届国会。这次选举后出现自1999年以来首个悬峙议会。组建联合政府的尝试未能成功，因此土耳其决定于2015年11月提前举行大选。

en.s: Presidential primaries and caucuses of the Republican Party took place within all 50 U.S. states, the District of Columbia, and five U.S. territories between February 1 and June 7, 2016. These elections selected the 2,472 delegates that were sent to the Republican National Convention. Businessman and reality television personality Donald Trump won the Republican nomination for president of the United States.

zh.s: 共和党总统初选和党团会议于2016年2月1日至6月7日在美国全部50个州、哥伦比亚特区和5个美国属地举行，选出2,472名代表参加共和党全国代表大会。商人兼真人秀电视名人唐纳德·特朗普赢得共和党总统候选人提名。

en.s: The 2016 Sacramento mayoral election was held on June 7, 2016, to elect the mayor of Sacramento, California. It saw the election of Darrell Steinberg. Since Steinberg won a majority in the first round, no runoff was required. Municipal elections in California are officially non-partisan.

zh.s: 加利福尼亚州萨克拉门托市于2016年6月7日举行市长选举，达雷尔·斯坦伯格当选。由于他在首轮投票中获得多数选票，无需举行决选。加州的市级选举在法律上不设党派。

en.s: Bakersfield, California, held a general election for mayor on June 7, 2016, and November 8, 2016. It saw the election of Karen Goh. Municipal elections in California are officially non-partisan.

zh.t: 2016年加利福尼亚州贝克斯菲尔德市长选举
zh.s: 加利福尼亚州贝克斯菲尔德市于2016年6月7日和11月8日举行市长大选，凯伦·高当选。

en.s: Stockton, California, held an election for mayor on June 7, 2016 and November 8, 2016. It saw Michael Tubbs unseat incumbent mayor Anthony Silva Tubbs became the youngest mayor in Stockton's history and its first African American mayor. Municipal elections in California are officially non-partisan.

zh.t: 2016年加利福尼亚州斯托克顿市长选举
zh.s: 加利福尼亚州斯托克顿市于2016年6月7日和11月8日举行市长选举。迈克尔·塔布斯击败时任市长安东尼·席尔瓦当选，成为斯托克顿历史上最年轻的市长，也是首位非裔市长。加州的市级选举在法律上不设党派。

en.s: The 2016 San Diego mayoral election was held on Tuesday, June 7, 2016, to elect the mayor of San Diego. Incumbent Kevin Faulconer ran for a second term as mayor against former San Diego City Council member Ed Harris and former California State Assembly member Lori Saldaña. Municipal elections in California are officially non-partisan, though some candidates do receive funding and support from various political parties.

zh.s: 加利福尼亚州圣迭戈市于2016年6月7日（星期二）举行市长选举。时任市长凯文·福尔科纳竞选第二个任期，对手包括前圣迭戈市议员埃德·哈里斯和前加州众议员洛里·萨尔达尼亚。加州的市级选举在法律上不设党派，不过一些候选人会获得政党的资金和支持。

en.t: 2017 Myanmar Air Force Shaanxi Y-8 crash
en.s: On 7 June 2017, a Shaanxi Y-8 aircraft of the Myanmar Air Force crashed on a flight from Myeik to Yangon, killing all 122 people on board. Debris from the aircraft was found in the Andaman Sea, 118 nautical miles (218 km) off Dawei by Myanmar Navy ships. It is the deadliest aviation accident in Myanmar's history.

zh.t: 2017年缅甸空军运-8飞机坠毁事故
zh.s: 2017年6月7日，缅甸空军一架运-8飞机在从梅尔桂飞往仰光途中坠毁，机上122人全部遇难。缅甸海军舰艇在土瓦以西118海里（218公里）的安达曼海发现飞机残骸。这是缅甸历史上死亡人数最多的空难。

zh.t: 2018年职业格斗联盟第一站赛事

en.s: General elections were held on June 7, 2018, to elect the 124 members of the 42nd Parliament of Ontario. The Progressive Conservative Party of Ontario, led by Doug Ford, won 76 of the 124 seats in the legislature and formed a majority government. The Ontario New Democratic Party, led by Andrea Horwath, formed the Official Opposition.

zh.s: 安大略省于2018年6月7日举行大选，选出第42届省议会124名议员。道格·福特领导的安大略进步保守党赢得124席中的76席，组建多数政府。安大略新民主党由安德莉亚·霍瓦斯领导，成为官方反对党。

en.s: The 2019 Super ShowDown was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) and livestreaming event produced by the American company WWE, held for wrestlers from the promotion's main roster brands, Raw, SmackDown, and 205 Live. It was the second annual Super ShowDown (restylized from "Super Show-Down" the prior year) and took place on Friday, June 7, 2019, at the King Abdullah Sports City's King Abdullah International Stadium in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia.

zh.s: 《疯人笼》（西班牙语字面意为“疯子的笼子”，借指西班牙语片名《疯女之笼》）是国际摔角革命集团（IWRG）举办的一场职业摔角特别赛事，于2019年6月7日在墨西哥州瑙卡尔潘的瑙卡尔潘竞技场举行。

en.s: The 2020 NXT TakeOver: In Your House was a professional wrestling livestreaming event produced by WWE, held for wrestlers from the promotion's NXT brand division. It was simultaneously the 29th NXT TakeOver event, the 28th In Your House event, and the first annual In Your House for NXT. The event was streamed exclusively on the WWE Network on June 7, 2020.

en.s: The 2020 Icelandic Super Cup was the 49th final in the Icelandic Super Cup, an annual game between the League champions and the Cup champions. The match was played at KR-völlur in Reykjavík on 7 June.

en.t: 2022 Orange County, California District Attorney election
en.s: The 2022 Orange, County, California District Attorney election was held on June 7, 2022. Incumbent District Attorney Todd Spitzer ran for a second term. Spitzer was first elected in 2014 with 53.2% of the vote in 2018. Because Spitzer got a majority of the vote in the first round, he avoided a runoff and won a second term in the first round.

zh.t: 2022年加利福尼亚州奥兰治县地方检察官选举
zh.s: 加利福尼亚州奥兰治县地方检察官选举于2022年6月7日举行。时任地方检察官托德·斯皮策竞选第二个任期。斯皮策于2014年首次当选，2018年得票率为53.2%。由于他在首轮投票中获得过半数选票，无需决选，直接赢得连任。

en.s: The 2022 California's 22nd congressional district special election took place on June 7, 2022, with the primary election on April 5, 2022. California's 22nd congressional district became vacant when Republican representative Devin Nunes resigned on January 1, 2022, to become the CEO of the Trump Media & Technology Group. Governor Gavin Newsom scheduled the special election for June 7, 2022, with the primary election on April 5, 2022.

zh.t: 2022年加利福尼亚州第22国会选区特别选举
zh.s: 加利福尼亚州第22国会选区特别选举于2022年6月7日举行，初选于同年4月5日举行。共和党众议员德文·努涅斯于2022年1月1日辞职，出任特朗普媒体与科技集团首席执行官，留下席位空缺。州长加文·纽森安排特别选举于6月7日举行，并定于4月5日举行初选。

en.t: 2022 San Francisco District Attorney recall election
en.s: The 2022 San Francisco District Attorney recall election was a successful special recall election to remove San Francisco District Attorney Chesa Boudin from office. It was held on June 7, 2022, concurrent with the 2022 statewide primary elections. In the recall election, 55% of voters supported Boudin's removal, successfully removing him from office.

zh.t: 2022年旧金山地方检察官罢免选举
zh.s: 旧金山于2022年6月7日举行地方检察官特别罢免选举，并成功罢免切萨·布丁。选举与2022年州级初选同时举行。55%的选民支持罢免布丁，他因此被免职。

en.t: 2022 Los Angeles County Board of Supervisors election
en.s: The 2022 Los Angeles County Board of Supervisors elections took place on June 7, 2022, with runoff elections held on November 8, 2022, to elect members of the Los Angeles County Board of Supervisors. Two of the five seats on the board were up for election to four-year terms. Municipal elections in California are officially nonpartisan; candidates' party affiliations do not appear on the ballot.

en.s: The 2022 Long Beach mayoral election was held on June 7, 2022. Because no candidate reached 50% of the vote, there was a runoff election on November 8, 2022. zh.t: 2022年加利福尼亚州长滩市长选举

en.s: The 2022 Los Angeles elections were held on June 7, 2022. Voters elected candidates in a nonpartisan primary, with runoff elections scheduled for November 8, 2022. Eight of the fifteen seats in the City Council were up for election while three of the seven seats in the LAUSD Board of Education were up for election. The seat of Mayor of Los Angeles was up for election due to incumbent Eric Garcetti's term limit.

en.t: 2022 FIFA World Cup qualification – AFC fourth round
en.s: The fourth round of AFC matches for the 2022 FIFA World Cup qualification consisted of a single match that determined the AFC representative in the intercontinental play-offs against the CONMEBOL representative. This round was originally scheduled as a two-legged tie for 11 and 16 November 2021, but the dates and format were changed in November 2020 in response to impacts from the COVID-19 pandemic in Asia.

en.t: 2022 California Superintendent of Public Instruction election
en.s: The 2022 California Superintendent of Public Instruction election was held on June 7 and November 8, 2022, to elect the Superintendent of Public Instruction of California. Unlike most other elections in the state, the office is not elected under the state's top-two primary system. Instead, the officially nonpartisan position is elected at a primary election, with a runoff at a general election if no candidate receives a majority of the vote.

en.s: The 2023 UEFA Europa Conference League final was the final match of the 2022–23 UEFA Europa Conference League, the second season of Europe's tertiary club football tournament organised by UEFA. The match was played at the Fortuna Arena in Prague, Czech Republic, on 7 June 2023, between Italian club Fiorentina and English club West Ham United. West Ham United won the match 2–1 for their first UEFA Europa Conference League title.

zh.s: 2023年欧洲协会联赛决赛是2022—2023赛季欧洲协会联赛的决赛，赛事由欧洲足球协会联盟主办，是欧洲第三级别俱乐部足球赛事的第二个赛季。比赛于2023年6月7日在捷克布拉格的福图纳竞技场举行，由意大利佛罗伦萨队对阵英格兰西汉姆联队。西汉姆联以2比1获胜，首次夺得欧洲协会联赛冠军。

en.s: The 2023 Canadian Championship final was the deciding match of the 2023 Canadian Championship and was played on June 7, 2023. For the second year in a row, it was hosted at BC Place in Vancouver, British Columbia by defending champions Vancouver Whitecaps FC, who played CF Montréal. This was the third final played between Vancouver and Montreal, with the clubs having met in the 2013 and 2015 finals.

zh.s: 2023年加拿大锦标赛决赛于2023年6月7日举行，决出该届赛事冠军。连续第二年，卫冕冠军温哥华白帽队在不列颠哥伦比亚省温哥华的BC体育馆主场迎战蒙特利尔足球俱乐部。这是温哥华与蒙特利尔第三次在决赛交手，此前两次分别在2013年和2015年。

en.s: An election to decide the first directly elected Mayor of Limerick was held on 7 June 2024, as part of the 2024 Irish local elections. en.s: The 2024 Irish local elections were held in all local authorities in Ireland on Friday, 7 June 2024. European Parliament elections were held on the same day. It also included the 2024 Limerick mayoral election, for the first directly elected mayor in Ireland. Each local government area (a city, a county, or a city and county) is divided into local electoral areas (LEAs) where three to seven councillors are elected on the system of proportional representation by means of the single transferable vote (PR-STV).

en.t: 2025 Green Party of Prince Edward Island leadership election

Previous leader Peter Bevan-Baker resigned following the significant loss of party seats in the previous provincial election.

en.s: The 2025 San Antonio mayoral election was held on May 3, 2025, to elect the next mayor of San Antonio, Texas. Due to the passage of Proposition F in 2024, the winner will receive a four-year term, as term limits were changed from four two-year terms to two four-year terms.
